a: Nefal lego challa, may? amar leh rav hillel lerav ashe: hava ovada be rav kahana, vaasar rav kahana. amar leh: hahu immartute immartat.
Ravina sevar leshaore bima vechad, amar: la gara mitteruma, ditnan: teruma ola beechad umea. amar leh rav tachlifa bar gizza leravina: dilma ketavlin shel teruma bikdera dame, dela batel tamayyhu!
Rav achay shayar bechalla bechamshin, rav shemuel bereh derav ika shayar beshichra beshittin.
Vehilcheta: idde veidde beshittin, vechen kol issurin shebbattora.

Mishna nochri shehaya maavir im yisrael kadde yayin mimmakom lemakom, im haya bechezkat hammishtammer — muttar. im hodio shehu maflig kede sheyyishtom veyistom veyiggov. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kede sheyyiftach et hechavit veyiggof vetiggov.
Hammanniach yeno bekaron o bisfina, vehalach lo bekafendarya, nichnas limdina verachatz — muttar.
Im hodio shehu maflig — kede sheyyishtom, veyistom, veyiggov. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kede sheyyiftach et hechavit, veyiggof, vetiggov.

Hammanniach nochri bachanut, af al pi sheyyotze venichnas — muttar, veim hodio shehu maflig — kede sheyyishtom veyistom veyiggov. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kede sheyyiftach et hechavit veyiggof vetiggov.

Haya ochel immo al hashshulechan, vehinniach leginin al hashshulechan velagin al haddulebki, vehinnicho veyatza — ma sheal hashshulechan asur, sheal haddulebki muttar. veim amar lo: heve mozeg veshote — af sheal haddulebki asur. chaviyyot petuchot asurot, setumot muttarot, kede sheyyiftach veyiggof vetiggov.

Gemara hechi dame "bechezkat hammishtammer"? kidtanya: hare shehayu chamarav ufoalav teunin teharot, afillu hiflig mehen yoter mimmil — tohorotav tehorot, veim amar lahen: "lechu vaani ba acharechem", kevan shennitallema eno mehem — tohorotav temeot.
May shena resha, umay shena sefa? amar rav yitzchak: resha bimtaher chamarav ufoalav lechach.
I hachi, sefa name? en am haaretz makpid al magga chavero. i hachi, afillu resha name nema hachi!
Amar rava:
b: Beva lahem derech akallaton. i hachi, sefa name? kevan deamar lahem "lechu vaani ba acharechem", samcha datayyhu.

Hammanniach nochri bachanuto kulei. hammanniach yeno bekaron o bisfina kulei. utzericha, dei tena nochri — desavar: dilma ate vechaze leh, aval bekaron o bisfina — ema demafleg la lisfinteh veaved may devae.
Vei tena bekaron o bisfina, mishshum desavar: dilma ate beorcha achariti vekae aggudda vechaze li, aval nochri bachanuto ema: ached le levava veaved kol devae, ka mashma lan.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: machloket beshel sid, aval beshel tit — divre hakkol kede sheyyiftach veyiggof veyiggov.
Metivi: amar rabban shimon ben gamliel lachachamim: vahalo sittumo nikkar ben millemala uven millematta.
I amrat bishlama beshel tit machloket, hayeynu dekatane: sittumo nikkar ben millemala uven millematta, ella i amrat beshel sid machloket, bishlama lematta yedia, ella lemala ha la yedia.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel hu dela yada may kaamri rabbanan, vehachi kaamar lehu: i beshel tit kaamritu — sittumo nikkar ben millemala uven millematta, vei beshel sid kaamritu — nehi dilmala la yedia, lematta miha yedia. verabbanan, kevan demillemala la yedia, la massik addateh deafech vachaze leh. i name, zimnin dechalem.
Amar rava: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, hoil utenan setama kevavteh.

Ditnan: haya ochel al hashshulechan immo, vehinniach lagin al hashshulechan, lagin al haddulebki vehinniach veyatza — ma sheal hashshulechan asur, ma sheal haddulebki muttar, veim amar lo: heve mozeg veshote — af sheal haddulebki asur. chaviyyot petuchot asurot, setumot muttarot, kede sheyyiftach veyiggof vetiggov.
Peshita! mahu detema: kullah rabban shimon ben gamliel katane la? ka mashma lan.

Vechi meachar dekayyma lan kevavteh derabban shimon ben gamliel dela chayesh leshittuma, vehilcheta kevavteh derabbi eliezer dela chayesh leziyyufa, haiddana may tama la motvinan chamra beyad goyim? mishshum shayyka.
Amar rava: zona goya, veyisrael mesubbin etzlah — chamra shere, nehi detakef lehu yitzra daavera,

a: Yitzra deyen nesech la takef lehu. zona yisreelit vegoyim mesubbin — chamra asur, may tama? hoil vezila alayyhu, batrayyhu gerira.

Hahu beta dahava yatev beh chamra deyisrael, al goy achda ledashsha beappeh, vahava biza bedashsha, ishtechach goy dekae bene danne. amar rava: kol delahade biza — shere, dehay gisa vehay gisa — asir.

Hahu chamra deyisrael, dahava yatev beveta, dahava dayayr yisrael baelyona vegoy battachtona. shemau kal tigra, nafki, kedem ata goy achda ledashsha beappeh. amar rava: chamra shere, memar amar: ki hechi dikdem atay ana, kedem vaata yisrael veyatev baelyona veka chaze li.
Hahu ushepiza dahava yatev beh chamra deyisrael, ishtechach goy dahava yatev be danne. amar rava: im nitpas alav kegannav — shere, vei la — asir.

Hahu beta dahava yatev beh chamra, ishtechach goy dahava kaem be danne. amar rava: i it leh leishtemote — chamra asir, vei la — chamra shere. metivi: ninal happunedak, o sheamar lo: "shemor" — asur. may lav af al gav delet leh leishtemote? la, bidit leh leishtemote.
Hahu yisrael vegoy dahavo yatvi veka shatu chamra, shema yisrael kal tzalloye be chenishta, kam vaazal. amar rava: chamra shere, memar amar: hasheta middechar leh lechamreh vehadar ate.
Hahu yisrael vegoy dahavo yatvi bearba, shema yisrael kal shippure deve shimshe, nefak vaazal. amar rava: chamra shere, memar amar: hasheta middechar leh lechamreh vehadar ate.

Vei mishshum shabbeta, haamar rava: amar li issur giyyora, ki havenan bearmayutan amrinan: yehudae la menatteri shabbeta, dei menatteri shabbeta kamma kise ka mishtachchi beshuka. vela yadana disvira lan kerabbi yitzchak, deamar rabbi yitzchak: hammotze kis beshabbat molicho pachot pachot mearba ammot.
Hahu arya dahava nahem bematzarta, shema goy, tesha bene danne. amar rava: chamra shere, memar amar: ki hechi detashena ana, itsha name yisrael achorayy veka chaze li.
Hanhu gannave desalki lefumebdita, ufetachu chavyata tuva. amar rava: chamra shere. may tama? rubba gannave yisrael ninhu. hava ovada binhardea, veamar shemuel: chamra shere.
Keman? kerabbi eliezer, deamar: sefek bia tahor.

Ditnan: hannichnas levika bimot haggeshamim, vetumea besade pelonit, veamar: halachti bammakom hallaz, veeni yodea im nichnasti leotah sade im lo nichnasti, rabbi eliezer omer: sefek bia — tahor, sefek magga — tame!
La, shane hatam, kevan deikka defatchi leshum mamona, have leh sefek sefeka.
b: Hahi revita deishtechach dahavat be danne, vahavat nekita ufeya bida, amar rava: chamra shere, emar miggabba dechavita shekalteh, veaf al gav delekka tu, emar itremoye itremi la.

Hahu pulemusa dislek linhardea, petachu chavyata tuva. ki ata rav dimi amar: ovada hava kammeh derabbi elazar, ushera. vela yadana, i mishshum desavar la kerabbi eliezer deamar: sefek bia tahor, i mishshum desavar: rubba deazli bahade pulemusa yisrael ninhu.
I hachi, hay sefek bia? sefek magga hu! kevan demippatchi tuva, ema addata demamona petachu, vechisfek bia dame.
Hahi masovita dimsara la ikkelida (maftecha) legoya, amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi elazar: ovada hava be midresha, vaamaru: lo masra lah ella shemirat mafteach bilvad.
Amar abbaye: af anan name tenena: hammoser maftechot leam haaretz — tohorotav tehorot, lefi shello masar lo ella shemirat mafteach bilvad. hasheta tohorotav tehorot, yen nesech mibbaya?
Lememra ditharot allimi miyyen nesech? in, deittemar: chatzer shechillekah bimsifas, amar rav: tohorotav temeot, uvegoy eno ose yen nesech, verabbi yochanan amar: af tohorotav tehorot.
Metivi: happenimit shel chaver vehachitzona shel am haaretz, oto chaver shoteach sham perot umanniach sham kelim, veaf al pi sheyyado shel am haaretz maggaat lesham. kashya lerav!
Amar lecha rav: shane hatam, shennitpas alav kegannav.

Ta shema: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: gaggo shel chaver lemala miggaggo shel am haaretz, oto chaver shoteach sham perot umanniach sham kelim, uvilvad shello tehe yado shel am haaretz maggaat lesham. kashya lerabbi yochanan!
Amar lach rabbi yochanan: shane hatam, deit leh leishtemote, memar amar: immetzore ka mimmetzarna.

Ta shema: gaggo shel chaver betzad gaggo shel am haaretz, oto chaver shoteach sham perot umanniach sham kelim, veaf al pi sheyyado shel am haaretz maggaat lesham. kashya lerav! amar lecha rav: lav ikka rabbi shimon ben gamliel dekae kevavti? ana daamari kerabbi shimon ben gamliel.
Mishna boleshet shennichnesa leir, bishat shalom — chaviyyot petuchot asurot, setumot muttarot; bishat milchama — ellu veellu muttarot, lefi sheen penay lenassech.

a: Gemara ureminhi: ir shekkevashuha karkom — kol kohanot shebbetochah pesulot! amar rav mari: lenassech en penay, livol yesh penay.
Mishna haummanin shel yisrael sheshshalach lahem nochri chavit shel yen nesech bischaran — muttar lomar: "ten lanu et dameha", mishshennichnesa lirshutan — asur.
Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: muttar laadam lomar legoy: "tze vehafes alay menat hammelech".
Metivi: al yomar adam legoy "ul tachtay laotzer". amar leh rav: "ul tachtay laotzer" kaamrat? ha la damya ella leha, aval omer lo "malleteni min haotzer".
Mishna hammocher yeno lenochri, pasak ad shello madad — damav muttarin, madad ad shello pasak — damav asurin.

Gemara amar ammemar: meshicha begoy kona, tidda, dehane parsae meshadderi pardashne lahadade vela hadri behu. rav ashe amar: leolam ema lach, meshicha begoy enah kona, vehay dela hadri behu — deramut rucha hu dinkita lehu.

Amar rav ashe: mena amena la? middeamar lehu rav lehanhu savoyata: ki chayylitu chamra legoyim, shiklu zuze minnayyhu vahadar (kayylan) [kayylu] lehu, vei la nekitu bahadayyhu zuze, ozifunehu vahadar shekilu minnayyhu, ki hechi detihve halevaa gabbayyhu, dei la avditu hachi, ki ka have yen nesech — birshutayychu ka have, vechi shakylitu deme yen nesech ka shakylitu. vei salka datach meshicha begoy kona
b: Middemashche goy kanyeh, yen nesech la have ad denaga beh!
I deka chayel verame lemana deyisrael, hachi name. la tzericha deka chayel verame lemana degoy.
Sof sof, ki meta leavvera demana kanyeh, yen nesech la have ad demate leariteh demana, shema minna nitztzok chibbur?
La, i denaket leh goy lichli bideh — hachi name; la tzericha demannach aara.
Vetikkene leh kilyo! shamat minna: kilyo shel lokeach birshut mocher — lo kana lokeach.
La, leolam ema lach: kana lokeach, vehacha bemay askinan? kegon deikka akkevet yayin appummay dechuzanta, dekamma kamma innesech leh.
Ucheman? dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel, dei rabban shimon ben gamliel, haamar: yimmacher kullo legoyim chutz middeme yen nesech shebbo!
Midde hu tama, ella lerav, haamar rav: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel — chavit bechavit, aval lo yayin beyayin.

Metivi: hallokeach gerutaot min haggoyim umatza bahen avoda zara, im ad shello natan maot mashach — yachazir, im mishshennatan maot mashach — yolich leyam hammelach. i salka datach meshicha begoy kona, ammay yachzir? amar abbaye: mishshum demichaze ki mikkach taut.

Amar rava: resha mikkach taut, sefa lav mikkach taut? ella amar rava: resha vesefa mikkach taut, veresha dela yahev zuze — la mitchaze kaavoda zara beyad yisrael, sefa deyahev zuze — mitchaze kaavoda zara beyad yisrael.

Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe: ta shema, hammocher yeno lenochri, pasak ad shello madad — damav muttarim. vei amrat meshicha begoy enah kona, ammay damav muttarin? hacha bemay askinan — deakdem leh dinar.
I hachi, ema sefa: madad ad shello pasak — damav asurin, vei dekadem leh dinar, ammay damav asurin?
Amar leh: uledidach deamrat meshicha begoy kona, ammay resha damav muttarin, vesefa damav asurin?
Ella may it lach lememar? pasak — samcha dateh; lo pasak — la samcha dateh.
Ledidi name, af al gav dikdem leh dinar — pasak, samcha dateh; lo pasak, la samcha dateh.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: ta shema, deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: ben noach neherag al pachot mishshave peruta, velo nittan lehishshavon, vei amrat meshicha begoy enah kona, ammay neherag?
Mishshum detzaareh leyisrael.

a: Umay "lo nittan lehishshavon"? deeno betorat hishshavon.
I hachi, ema sefa: ba chavero unetalah mimmennu — neherag aleha. bishlama resha, mishshum detzaareh leyisrael, ella sefa, may aved?
Ella shema minna, meshicha begoy kona, shema minna.
Hahu gavra daamar leh lechavreh: "i mezabbenna la leha ara — lach mezabbenna la", azal zabbena leinish acharina, amar rav yosef: kena kamma.
Amar leh abbaye: veha la pesak! umena temra dechol hecha dela pesak la kena? ditnan: hammocher yeno lenochri, pasak ad shello madad — damav muttarin, madad ad shello pasak — damav asurin.
May have ala? may have ala?! kidkaamrinan! dilma chumera deyen nesech shane.

Ta shema, deamar rav idi bar avin: ovada hava be rav chisda, verav chisda be rav huna, ufashtuyha meha ditnan: mashach chamarav ufoalav vehichnisan letoch beto, ben pasak ad shello madad uven madad ad shello pasak — lo kana, ushenehen yecholin lachazor bahen.
Perkan vehichnisan letoch beto, pasak ad shello madad — en shenehen yecholin lachazor bahen, madad ad shello pasak — shenehen yecholin lachazor bahen.

Hahu gavra daamar leh lechavreh: "i mezabbenna la leha ara — mezabbenna lach bima zuze", azal zabbena leinish acharina bima veesrin. amar rav kahana: kena kamma. matkef la rav yaakov minnehar pekod: hay zuze ansu! vehilcheta kerav yaakov minnehar pekod.
Amar leh "kidshayymi bitlata" — afillu tere miggo telata. "kidamri bitlata" — ad deamri bitlata. "kidshayymi bearbea" — ad deamri bearbaa, vechol shekken hecha daamar leh "kidamri bearbaa".

Amar leh: "kidshayymi bitlata", vaato telata veshamuha, vaamar leh iddach: leto telata acharine dekim lehu tefe! amar rav pappa: dina hu dimakkev. matkef la rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: mimmay dehane kim lehu tefe? dilma hane kim lehu tefe! vehilcheta kerav huna bereh derav yehoshua.

Mishna natal et hammashpech umadad letoch tzelochito shel nochri, vechazar umadad letoch tzelochito shel yisrael, im yesh bo akkevet yayin — asur. hameare mikkeli el keli, et sheera mimmennu — muttar, veet sheera letocho — asur.
Gemara tenan hatam: hannitztzok, vehakkatafres, umashke tofeach — eno chibbur, lo letumea velo letohora. haashboren — chibbur letumea uletohora.
Amar rav huna: nitztzok vekatafres umashke tofeach chibbur leinyan yen nesech.

Amar leh rav nachman lerav huna: mena lach ha? illema midditnan: hannitztzok vehakkatafres umashke tofeach eno chibbur lo letumea velo letohora, letumea uletohora hu dela have chibbur, ha leinyan yen nesech have chibbur — ema sefa: haashboren chibbur letumea uletohora, letumea uletohora hu dehave chibbur, ha leinyan yen nesech la have chibbur. ella meha lekka lemishma minna.
Tenan: natal et hammashpech umadad letoch tzelochito shel nochri, vechazar umadad letoch tzelochito shel yisrael.
b: Im yesh bo akkevet yayin — asur. ha akkevet yayin bemay ka mittasra? lav benitztzok? shema minna: nitztzok chibbur.
Tane rabbi chiyyay: sheppechasattu tzelochito, aval lo pechasattu tzelochito — may? la, tifshot denitztzok eno chibbur! la, pechasattu tzelochito — tifshot lach deasur, nitztzok — tibbee.
Ta shema: hameare mikkeli lichli, et shemmeare mimmennu — muttar, ha devene bene — asur. shema minna: nitztzok chibbur.
I nitztzok chibbur, afillu degavveh demana name littesar! ha la kashya, deka mekattef kattofe. mikkol makom, nitztzok chibbur!
Uletamaych, ema sefa: et sheera letocho hu daasir, ha devene bene shere! ella, meha lekka lemishma minna.
Ta shema: hameare mechavit labbor, killuach hayyored missefat chavit lematta — asur! targema rav sheshet: begoy hameare, deate mikkocho.
I goy hameare, afillu gavva dechavita name mittesar! koach degoy midderabbanan hu daasir, hahu dinfak levaray — gezaru beh rabbanan, hahu dilgavvay — la gezaru beh rabbanan.

Amar lehu rav chisda lehanhu savoyata: ki chayylitu chamra legoyim — (katfi) [kattifu] kattofe, i name (naftzi) [nappitzu] nappotze. amar lehu rava lehanhu shafochae: ki shafchitu chamra — la likrav goy lesayyay bahadayychu, dilma mishtelitu veshadetu leh aleh, vekaate mikkocho vaasir.
Hahu gavra deassek chamra begishta uvat gishta, ata goy annach yedeh aggishta, asreh rava lechulleh chamra.
Amar leh rav pappa lerava, veamri la rav adda bar matna lerava, veamri la ravina lerava: bemay? benitztzok. shamat minna nitztzok chibbur? shane hatam, dechulle chamra aggishta uvat gishta gerir.
Amar mar zutera bereh derav nachman: kenishkenin shere, vehane mille dikdem pesak yisrael, aval kedem pesak goy — la. rabba bar rav huna ikkela leve resh galuta, shera lehu lemishte biknishkenin.

a: Ikka deamri: rabba bar rav huna gufeh ishti biknishkenin.
Mishna yen nesech asur veoser bechol shehu, yayin beyayin umayim bemayim bechol shehu, yayin bemayim umayim beyayin benoten taam.
Ze hakkelal: min bemino — bemashshehu, veshello bemino — benoten taam.
Gemara ki ata rav dimi amar rabbi yochanan: hameare yen nesech mechavit labbor, afillu kol hayyom kullo — rishon rishon batel.
Tenan: yen nesech asur veoser bechol shehu. may lav deka nafel issura lego hettera? la, deka nafel hettera lego issura.
Ta shema: yayin bemayim — benoten taam. may lav deka nafel chamra deissura lemayya dehettera? la, deka nafel chamra dehettera lemayya deissura.

Umidderesha bemayya deissura, sefa name bemayya deissura, vekatane sefa: mayim beyayin — benoten taam! amar lecha rav dimi: kullah matnitin hettera lego issura, veresha deka nafel chamra dehettera lemayya deissura, sefa deka nafel mayya dehettera lachamara deissura.

Ki ata rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yochanan: hameare yen nesech mitztzartzur katan levor, afillu kol hayyom kullo — rishon rishon batel. vedavka tzartzur katan, dela nefish ammudeh, aval chavit dinfish ammudeh — la.
Ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: yen nesech shennafal labbor, venafal sham kiton shel mayim — roin et hahetter keillu eno, vehashshear mayim ravin alav umevattelin oto.
Ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda, amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shennafal kiton shel mayim techilla, aval lo nafal sham kiton shel mayim techilla — matza min et mino veneor.

Ikka dematne la ammatnitin: yayin beyayin — kol shehu. amar rav shemuel bar yehuda amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shello nafal sham kiton shel mayim, aval nafal sham kiton shel mayim — roin et hahetter keillu eno, vehashshear mayim ravin alav umevattelin oto.
May ikka ben lidmatne la ammatnitin, ben lidmatne la adderavin? man dematne la ammatnitin — la bae techilla, uman dematne la adderavin — bae techilla.
Ittemar: yen nesech shennafal labbor, venafal sham kiton shel mayim,
b: Amar chizkiyya: higdilu beissur — asur, higdilu behetter — muttar.
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu higdilu beissur — muttar.
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: lema chizkiyya verabbi yochanan biflugeta derabbi eliezer verabbanan kamippalgi?
Ditnan: seor shel chullin veshel teruma shennaflu letoch haissa, lo baze kede lechammetz velo baze kede lechammetz, venitztarfu vechimmetzu,
Rabbi eliezer omer: achar acharon ani ba, vachachamim omrim: ben shennafal issur battechilla uven bassof — eno asur ad sheyyehe bo kede lehachemitz.
Vetisbera?! vehaamar abbaye: lo shanu ella shekkadam vesillek et haissur, aval lo kadam vesillek et haissur — asur. chizkiyya deamar keman?
Ella, hacha beroin kamippalgi: lechizkiyya let leh roin, lerabbi yochanan it leh.
Umi it leh lerabbi yochanan roin? veha bae minneh rabbi assi merabbi yochanan: shene kosot, echad shel chullin veechad shel teruma, umezagan veervan ze baze mahu? vela peshat leh!

Meikkara la peshat leh, levassof peshat leh. ittemar name: amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: shene kosot, echad shel chullin veechad shel teruma, umezagan veervan ze baze — roin et hahetter keillu eno, vehashshear mayim ravin alav umevattelin oto.
Ze hakkelal: min bemino — bemashshehu, shello bemino — benoten taam.
Rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: kol issurin shebbattora — beminan bemashshehu, shello beminan — benoten taam.
Ze hakkelal — leetoye may? leetoye kol issurin shebbattora.

Rabbi yochanan veresh lakish deamri tarvayyhu: kol issurin shebbattora, ben beminan ben shello beminan — benoten taam, chutz mittevel veyen nesech — beminan bemashshehu, veshello beminan — benoten taam. veze hakkelal — leetoye tevel.
Tanya kevavteh derav ushemuel, tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan veresh lakish.
Tanya kevavteh derav ushemuel: kol issurin shebbattora, beminan — bemashshehu, shello beminan — benoten taam.

Tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan veresh lakish: kol issurin shebbattora, ben beminan ben shello beminan — benoten taam, chutz mittevel veyen nesech, beminan — bemashshehu, shello beminan — benoten taam.
Bishlama yen nesech, mishshum chumera daavoda zara, ella tevel may tama?
Kehettero kach issuro, deamar shemuel: chitta achat poteret et hakkeri. vetanya name hachi: bamme amru tevel oser bechol shehu? bemino, shello bemino — benoten taam.

a: Mishna ellu asurin, veosrin bechol shehu: yen nesech, vaavoda zara, veorot levuvin,
Veshor hanniskal, veegla arufa,
Vetzippore metzora, usear nazir, ufeter chamor, uvasar bechalav, vesair hammishtalleach, vechullin shennishchatu baazara — hare ellu asurin veosrin bechol shehu.

Gemara tanna may kachashev? i davar shebbeminyan kachashev, litne name chatichot nevela! i issure hanaa ka chashev, litne name chametz befesach! amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, veittema rabbi yitzchak nappacha: hay tanna tarte it leh — davar shebbeminyan veissure hanaa.
Velitne egoze perech verimmone badan, dedavar shebbeminyan veissure hanaa hu!
Ha tena leh hatam: harauy leorla — orla, harauy lechile hakkerem — kile hakkerem.
Velitne kikkarot shel baal habbayit leinyan chametz befesach! man shamat daamar la? rabbi akiva, ha tena leh hatam: rabbi akiva mosif af kikkarot shel baal habbayit.
"Hare ellu" lemaote may? lemaote davar shebbeminyan velav issure hanaa, i name lemaote issur hanaa velo davar shebbeminyan.
Mishna yen nesech shennafal labbor, kullo asur bahanaa. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: yimmacher kullo legoy, chutz middeme yen nesech shebbo.

Gemara amar rav: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel chavit bechaviyyot, aval lo yayin beyayin. ushemuel amar: afillu yayin beyayin. vechen amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: afillu yayin beyayin. vechen amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi chanina: afillu yayin beyayin. vechen amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: afillu yayin beyayin.
Amar rav nachman: halacha lemaase, yen nesech yayin beyayin — asur, chavit bechavit — muttar, setam yayin afillu yayin beyayin — muttar.
b: Mishna gat shel even shezzefatah goy, menaggevah vehi tehora. veshel etz, rabbi omer: yenaggev, vachachamim omrim: yiklof et hazzefet. veshel cheres, af al pi shekkalaf et hazzefet — hare zo asura.
Gemara amar rava: davka zefatah, aval darach bah — lo. peshita, "zefatah" tenan! mahu detema: hu haddin afillu darach bah, vehay dekatane "zefatah" — orcha demilleta katane, ka mashma lan.

Ikka deamri, amar rava: davka zefatah, aval darach bah la saggi la benigguv. peshita, "zefatah" tenan! mahu detema: hu haddin daafillu darach bah, vehay dekatane "zefatah" orcha demilleta katane, ka mashma lan davka zefatah, aval darach bah la saggi la benigguv.

Ki hahu daata lekammeh derabbi chiyyay, amar leh: hav li gavra (didche) [dimdakke] li matzartay, amar leh lerav: zil bahadeh vachazi dela metzavvechat alay be midresha. azal chazyay dahava shia tefe, amar: ha vadday benigguv saggi la. bahade deka azel veate, chaza pila mittuteh vachaza dahava mele chamra, amar: ha la saggi la benigguv ella bekilluf, vehayeynu daamar li chabbivi: chazi dela metzavvechat alay be midresha.

Tanu rabbanan: haggat vehammachatz vehammashpech shel goyim, rabbi mattir benigguv, vachachamim osrin. umode rabbi bekankannim shel goyim shehen asurin. uma hefresh ben ze laze? ze machniso bekiyyum, veze en machniso bekiyyum. veshel etz veshel even — yenaggev, veim hayu mezuppafin — asurin.
Vehatnan: gat shel even shezzefatah goy — menaggevah vehi tehora! matnitin delo darach bah, barayyta dedarach bah.

Amar mar: haggat vehammachatz vehammashpech shel goyim, rabbi mattir benigguv, vachachamim osrin. vehaanan tenan: shel cheres, af al pi shekkalaf et hazzefet — hare zo asura! amar rava: sefa dematnitin atan lerabbanan.

Daresh rava: naava artachu. rava ki hava meshaddar gulefe leharepanya, sachef lehu appummayyhu vechatem lehu abbirtzayyhu. kasavar: kol davar shemmachniso lekiyyum, afillu lefi shaa — gezaru beh rabbanan.
Bamme menaggevan? rav amar: bemayim, rabba bar bar chana amar: beefer. rav amar bemayim — bemayim velo beefer? rabba bar bar chana amar beefer — beefer velo bemayim? ella

a: Rav amar: bemayim, vehu haddin leefer. rabba bar bar chana amar: leefer, vehu haddin lemayim, vela peligi — ha berattivta, ha beyabbishta.
Ittemar be rav mishshemeh derav amri: tarte telat, ushemuel amar: telat arba.
Besura matnu hachi, befumebdita matnu: be rav amri mishshemeh derav: telat arba, ushemuel amar: arba chamesh.
Vela peligi, mar ka chashev mayya batrae, umar la kachashev mayya batrae.
Beo minneh merabbi avahu: hane gurege daarammae may?

Amar lehu rabbi avahu: tenetuha, hare shehayu gittav uvet baddav temein, uvikkesh laasotan betohora — haddappin vehaadashin vehallulavin maddichan, vehaakalin shel netzarin veshel bitzbutz menaggevan, veshel shifa veshel gemi meyashshenan shenem asar chodesh. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: mannichan miggat legat umibbad levad.
Hayeynu tanna kamma! ikka benayyhu: chorfe veafle.

Rabbi yose omer: harotze letaharan miyyad, magilan berotchin, o choltan beme zetim. rabban shimon ben gamliel mishshum rabbi yose omer: mannichan tachat tzinnor shemmemav mekallechin, o bemayan shemmemav rodfin. vechamma? ona.
Kederech sheamru beyen nesech, kach amru bitharot.
Kelappe leyay! bitharot kayyminan! ella, kederech sheamru bitharot, kach amru beyen nesech.

Kamma ona? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: o yom o layla. rabbi chana sheina, veamri la rabbi chana bar sheina, amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: chatzi yom vachatzi layla.
Amar rabbi shemuel bar yitzchak: vela peligi, ha bitkufat nisan vetishri, ha bitkufat tammuz vetevet.

Amar rav yehuda: hane revavke daarammae demazya — maddichan, deamra — menaggevan, dechittana — meyashshenan, vei ikka kitre — share lehu. hane dikule vechallata daarammae dechayti bechavle detzure — medichan,
b: Detzavta — lenaggevan, dechittana — meyashshenan, vei it behu kitre — share lehu.
Ittemar: am haaretz shehoshit yado laggat venaga beeshkolot, rabbi verabbi chiyyay — chad amar: eshkol vechol sevivotav temein, vechol haggat kullah tehora; vechad amar: kol haggat kullah name temea.

Uleman deamar: eshkol vechol sevivotav temeim, vechol haggat kullah tehora, may shena meha ditnan: sheretz shennimtza barechayim eno metamme ella mekom maggao, veim haya mashkin mehallech — hakkol tame?
Hatam la mafsek vela midde, hacha mafseki eshkolot.
Oro leh rabbanan lerabbi yirmeya, veamri la livreh derabbi yirmeya, kedivre haomer: eshkol vechol sevivotav temein, vechol haggat kullah tehora.

Mishna hallokeach kele tashmish min haggoyim, et sheddarko lehatebil — yatbil, lehageil — yagil, lelabben baur — yelabben baur. hashshappud vehaaskala — melabbenan baur, hassakkin — shafah vehi tehora.
Gemara tana: vechullan tzerichin tevila bearbaim sea. menahane mille? amar rava, deamar kera: "kol davar asher yavo vaesh taaviru vaesh vetaher", hosif lecha hakkatuv tohora acheret.
Tane bar kappara: mittoch shenneemar "beme nidda", shomea ani shetztzarich hazzaa shelishi ushevii, talmud lomar "ach" — chalak.
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "beme nidda"? mayim shennidda tovelet bahen, heve omer: arbaim sea.
Itzterich lemichtav "vetaher", veitzterich lemichtav "beme nidda". i ketav "vetaher", hava amena "vetaher" kol dehu, ketav rachamana "beme nidda".
Vei ketav rachamana beme nidda, hava amena heerev shemesh kenidda, ketav rachamana "vetaher" lealtar.

Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: afillu kelim chadashim bammashma, deha yeshanim velibbenan kachadashim damu, vaafillu hachi bae tevila. matkef la rav sheshet: i hachi, afillu zuza desarbala name! amar leh: kele seuda amurin bapparasha.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lo shanu ella bilkuchin, uchemaase shehaya, aval sheulin — la.
Rav yitzchak bar yosef zevan mana demarda miggoy, sevar lehatebilah, amar leh hahu merabbanan verabbi yaakov shemeh: ledidi mipparsha leh minneh derabbi yochanan: kele mattachot amurin bapparasha.

Amar rav ashe: hane kele zechuchit, hoil vechi nishtabberu yesh lahen takkana, kichle mattachot damu. kuneya, peligi ba rav acha veravina, chad amar: kitchillato, vechad amar: kesofo, vehilcheta kesofo.

Ibbaya lehu: mashkanta may? amar mar bar rav ashe: abba mashken leh goy kasa dechaspa, veatbeleh veishti beh, vela yadana i mishshum dekasavar mashkanta kizvine damya, i mishshum dechaze legoy dedateh leshakkoeh.

Tanu rabbanan: hallokeach kele tashmish min haggoyim, devarim shello nishtammesh bahen — matbilan vehen tehorin. devarim shennishtammesh bahen al yede tzonen, kegon kosot vekittoniyyot utzelochiyyot — maddichan umatbilan vehem tehorin. devarim shennishtammesh bahen al yede chammin, kegon hayyorot hakkumekmosin umechamme chammin — magilan umatbilan vehen tehorin. devarim shennishtammesh bahen al yede haur, kegon hashshappudin vehaaskelaot — melabbenan umatbilan vehen tehorin.
Vechullan shennishtammesh bahen ad shello yatbil veshello yagil veshello yelabben, tane chada: asur, vetanya iddach: muttar.
La kashya, ha keman deamar: noten taam lifgam — asur, ha keman deamar: noten taam lifgam — muttar.
Uleman deamar: noten taam lifgam — muttar, giule goyim deasar rachamana hechi mashkachat la?
Amar rav chiyyay bereh derav huna: lo asra tora ella kedera

a: Bat yoma, delav noten taam lifgam hu.
Mikkan veelach lishtere! gezera kedera sheenah bat yoma mishshum kedera bat yoma.
Veiddach? kedera bat yoma name mifgam pagma.
Rame leh rav amram lerav sheshet, tenan: hashshappudin vehaaskala — melabbenan baur, vehatanya gabbe kadashim: hashshappud vehaaskala — magilan bechammin!
Amar leh: amram beri, ma inyan kadashim etzel giule goyim? hacha hettera bala, hatam issura bala.
Amar rava: sof sof ki ka falet issura ka falet, ella amar rava: may hageala? name shetifa umerika.
Amar leh abbaye: mi dame? merika ushetifa betzonen, hageala bechammin! ella amar abbaye: yaggid alav reo — tena hacha libbun, vehu haddin lehageala; tena hatam hageala, vehu haddin lelibbun.
Amar leh rava: i hachi, litninhu lechullehu bachada, velitne chada beiddach achariti, velema: "yaggid alav reo"!
Ella amar rava: kadashim hayeynu tamayyhu, kidrav nachman amar rabba bar avu, deamar: kol yom vayom naase giul lachavero.

Tinach shelamim, dechevan delishne yamim mitachli, mikkamme denihve notar ka have giul. ella chattat, kevan dilyom velayla mitachla, ki mevashshel ba haiddana chattat — have notar, ki hadar mevashshel ba limchar o shelamim o chattat, ka falet notar dechattat dehaiddana bechattat ushelamim delimchar!
Amri: la tzericha, dechi mevashshel ba chattat haiddana, hadar mevashshel ba haiddana shelamim.
Dechattat delimchar, ushelamim deetmol, bahade hadade ka shalem zimnayyhu, vahadar mevashshel shelamim delimchar.
I hachi, hageala name la live! kashya.
Rav pappa amar: hay karid, hay la karid.
Rav ashe amar: leolam kedaamaran meikkara, hacha hettera bala, hacha issura bala.
Udeka kashya lach, dividdana deka falet issura ka falet, beiddana deka falet la iteh leissura beeneh.
Vead kamma melabbenan? amar rabbi minni: ad shettashshir kelippatan. vechetzad magilan? amar rav huna: yora ketanna betoch yora gedola.
Yora gedola, may? ta shema: dehahu duda dahavay be rav akavya, ahdar la.
b: Gedanfa delaysha appumma, umalleyav mayya veartecha. amar rava: man chakkim lemebad ki ha milleta, i lav rav akavya degavra rabba hu? kasavar: kevolo kach polto — ma bolo benitzotzot, af polto benitzotzot.

Hassakkin — shafah vehi tehora. amar rav ukeva bar chama: venoatzah asara peamim bakkarka. amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: uvekarka sheenah avuda. amar rav kahana: uvesakkin yafa sheen bah gummot. tanya name hachi: sakkin yafa sheen bah gummot noatzah asara peamim bekarka. amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: leechol bah tzonen.

Ki ha demar yehuda uvati bar tovi havo yatvi kammeh deshabbur malka, ayyto lekammayyhu etroga. pesak achal, pesak vehav leh levati bar tovi, hadar datza asra zimne beara, pesak hav leh lemar yehuda. amar leh bati bar tovi: vehahu gavra lav bar yisrael hu? amar leh: mar kim li begavveh, umar la kim li begavveh.
Ikka deamri, amar leh: iddechar may avadt beureta.
Hadran alach hassocher et happoel, uselika la massechet avoda zara.

a: Mishna horu bet din laavor al achat mikkol mitzvot haamurot battora, vehalach hayyachid veasa shogeg al pihem, ben sheasu veasa immahen, ben sheasu veasa acharehen, ben shello asu veasa – patur, mippene shettala bevet din.

Horu bet din, veyada echad mehen shettau, o talmid vehu rauy lehoraa, vehalach veasa al pihen – ben sheasu veasa immahen, ben sheasu veasa acharehen, ben shello asu veasa – hare ze chayyayv, mippene shello tala bevet din. ze hakkelal: hattole beatzmo chayyayv, vehattole bevet din – patur.
Gemara amar shemuel: leolam en bet din chayyayvin ad sheyyomru lahem "muttarin attem". rav dimi minnehardea amar: ad sheyyomru lahem "muttarin attem laasot". may tama? lefi shello nigmera horaa.
Amar abbaye, af anan name tenena: chazar leiro shana velimmed kederech shellimmed – patur, hora laasot – chayyayv.
Amar rabbi abba, af anan name tenena: horu lah bet din lehinnase, vehalcha vekilkela – chayyevet bekorban, shello hittiru lah ella lehinnase.
Amar ravina, af anan name tenena: "horu bet din laavor al achat mikkol mitzvot haamurot battora", tu la middi.

Ikka deamri, amar shemuel: en bet din chayyayvin ad sheyyomru lahem "muttarim attem laasot". rav dimi minnehardea amar: afillu "muttarim attem" – nigmera horaa. amar abbaye, veha la tenan hachi: chazar leiro, veshana o limmed kederech shellimmed – patur, hora laasot – chayyayv.
Amar rabbi abba, veha la tenan hachi: horu lah bet din lehinnase, vehalcha vekilkela – chayyevet bekorban, shello hittiru lah ella lehinnase.
Amar ravina, veha la tenan hachi: horu bet din laavor al achat mikkol mitzvot haamurot battora, tu la middi.

Vehalach hayyachid veasa shogeg al pihem. venitne: "veasa al pihem", "shogeg" lema li? amar rava: "shogeg" – leetoye horu bet din shechelev muttar, venitchallef lo chelev beshumman, vaachalo – patur. "al pihem" – al pihem mammash,
Veikka deamri, amar rava: "shogeg" – al pihem hu defatur, aval nitchallef lo chelev beshumman vaachalo – chayyayv.
Milleta difshita leh lerava kamibbaya leh lerami bar chama, divay rame bar chama: horu bet din shechelev muttar, venitchallef lo beshumman vaachalo, mahu?

Amar rava, ta shema: halach yachid veasa shogeg al pihem kulei. shogeg al pihem lema li? lav leetoye horu bet din shechelev muttar, venitchallef lo chelev beshumman vaachalo – patur. dilma shogeg al pihem hu defatur, aval nitchallef lo chelev beshumman vaachalo – chayyayv.
Ikka deamri, amar rava, ta shema: halach yachid veasa shogeg al pihem. may lav, shogeg al pihem hu defatur, aval nitchallef lo chelev beshumman vaachalo – chayyayv. dilma: o shogeg, o al pihem.
Biflugeta: horu bet din shechelev muttar, venitchallef lo chelev beshumman vaachalo – rav amar: patur, verabbi yochanan amar: chayyayv. metivi: "meam haaretz baasotah", perat limshummad.

Rabbi shimon ben yose omer mishshum rabbi shimon: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "asher lo teasena bishgaga veashem o hoda" – hashshav midiato, mevi korban al shiggato. lo shav midiato – eno mevi korban al shiggato.
Veim ita, ha lo shav midiato hu.
Amar rav pappa, kasavar rabbi yochanan: kevan dechi mityeda lehu leve dina, hadri behu, vehu name hadar beh – shav midiato karenan beh, vechayyayv.
Amar rava: mode rav sheeno mashlim lerov tzibbur, may tama? amar kera: "bishgaga" – ad sheyyehu kullan bishgaga echat.
Ben sheasu veasa immahen kulei. lema leh lemitna kol hane? bishlama resha – lo zo af zo katane. ella sefa dilchiyyuva, ippecha mibbee leh!
b: Zo veen tzarich lomar zo katane.
Veyada echad mehen shettau o talmid verauy lehoraa. tarte lema li? amar rava: itzterich, salka datach amena hane mille gemir usevir, aval gemir vela sevir – la.

Amar leh abbaye: lehoraa gemir usevir mashma! amar leh, ana hachi kaamena: i mehahi – hava amena hane mille gemir usevir, aval gemir vela sevir – la, tena rauy lehoraa, mimmishna yetera: afillu gemir vela sevir, sevir vela gemir.
Rauy lehoraa vechulei. kegon man? amar rava: kegon shimon ben azzay veshimon ben zoma. amar leh abbaye: ki hay gavvna mezid hu!

Uletamaych, ha detanya: "baasotah achat", yachid haose mippi atzmo – chayyayv, behoraat bet din – patur. ketzad? horu bet din shechelev muttar, venoda leechad mehen shettau, o talmid yoshev lifnehen verauy lehoraa kegon shimon ben azzay, yachol yehe patur? talmud lomar: "baasotah achat", yachid haose al pi atzmo – chayyayv, behoraat bet din – patur!
Ella hechi mashkachat la? kegon deyada deasur, veka tae bemitzva lishmoa divre chachamim. ledidi name, detau bemitzva lishmoa divre chachamim.
Ze hakkelal hattole beatzmo – chayyayv. leetoye may? leetoye mevaet behoraa.
Tole bevet din – leetoye horu bet din veyadu shettau vechazru bahen. ha behedya katane la! tane vahadar mefaresh.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: zo divre rabbi yehuda, aval chachamim omrim: yachid sheasa behoraat bet din – chayyayv. may rabbi yehuda? detanya: "im nefesh achat techeta vishgaga baasotah" – hare ellu shelosha miutin: haose mippi atzmo – chayyayv, behoraat bet din – patur.

May rabbanan? detanya, adayin ani omer: miut kahal shechatu – chayyayvin, sheen bet din meviin al yedehen par. rov kahal shechatu – yehu peturin, shehare bet din meviin al yedehem par. talmud lomar: "meam haaretz" – afillu rubbah, vaafillu kullah.

Bemay? illema beshiggat maase [bet din shello behoraa], bet din may avidtayyhu? shello behoraat bet din, bet din mi mayytu shello behoraa? ella behoraa. veha ki ketiv "meam haaretz" – beshiggat maase hu dichtiv!
Ella lav hachi kaamar: miut kahal shechatu beshiggat maase chayyayvin, sheen bet din meviin al yedehen par behoraa. ha hen chayyayvin.
Yachol rov tzibbur sheasu beshiggat maase yehu peturin, shehare bet din meviin alehem par [behoraa]? talmud lomar: "meam haaretz", afillu rubbo.
Amar rav pappa: mimmay? dilma lo hen velo bet din!

I hachi, may irya dekamhaddar al rubba lechiyyuva? lav mikkelal demiut behoraa kayyma leh demichayyeyvu behoraa?! unehaddar beresha al miuta demichayyayv beshiggat maase, ulevassof nihaddar al rubba lechiyyuva beshiggat maase!

Ella lav middela mehaddar al miut demichayyeyvin beshiggat maase, uvesof mehaddar al rubba lechiyyuva beshiggat maase. shema minna: miut behoraa chayyayvin – hen kisba useira, veshello behoraa – beshiggat maase chayyayvin.
Mikkede tarvayyhu setame tenan, mimmay dekammayyta rabbi yehuda uvatrayyta rabbanan? ema ippecha! man shamat leh dedaresh miute ki hay gavvna? rabbi yehuda hi, detanya, rabbi yehuda omer:

a: "Zot torat haola hi" – hare ellu shelosha miutin.

Veibbaet ema: adayin ani omer la matzet mokmat la kerabbi yehuda, dekatane: rov kahal shechatu – bet din meviin al yedehen par, vei rabbi yehuda haamar: tzibbur hu demayyte, bet din – la. ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: shiva shevatim shechatu – meviin shiva parim.

Verav nachman amar shemuel: zo divre rabbi meir, aval chachamim omrim: yachid sheasa behoraat bet din – chayyayv. may rabbi meir umay rabbanan? detanya: horu veasu – rabbi meir poter, vachachamim mechayyeyvin.

Man asu? illema bet din, may tama derabbanan dimchayyeyvi? vehatanya: yachol horu bet din veasu bet din, yachol yehu chayyayvin? talmud lomar: "hakkahal veasu", maase taluy bakkahal vehoraa teluya bevet din!

Ella horu bet din veasu rov kahal. may tama derabbi meir defoter? ella lav: horu bet din veasu miut kahal, uveha kamippalgi, mar savar: yachid sheasa behoraat bet din – patur, umar savar: yachid sheasa behoraat bet din – chayyayv.
Amar rav pappa: dechulle alma yachid sheasa behoraat bet din – patur, ella bet din mashlim lerov tzibbur kamippalgi.
Mar savar: bet din mashlim lerov tzibbur, umar savar: en bet din mashlim lerov tzibbur.
Veibbaet ema: horu bet din veasu rubbo shel kahal, uman chachamim – rabbi shimon hi, deamar: tzibbur mayyte uvet din mayyti.
Veibbaet ema: shevet sheasa behoraat bet dino, uman chachamim? rabbi yehuda hi, detanya: shevet sheasa behoraat bet dino, oto hashshevet chayyayv.
Veibbaet ema: kegon shechatu shishsha, vehen rubbo shel kahal, o shiva af al pi sheenan rubbo shel kahal, umatnitin manni? rabbi shimon ben elazar hi.
Detanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshemo: chatu shishsha vehen rubbo shel kahal, o shiva af al pi sheenan rubbo shel kahal – chayyayvin.

Amar rav assi: uvehoraa, hallech achar rov yoshve eretz yisrael, shenneemar: "vayyaas shelomo vaet hahi et hechag vechol yisrael immo kahal gadol millevo chamat ad nachal mitzrayim lifne Adonai elohenu shivat yamim veshivat yamim arbaa asar yom". mikkede ketiv: "vechol yisrael immo", "kahal gadol millevo chamat ad nachal mitzrayim" lema li? shema minna: hane hu deikkeri kahal, aval hanach la ikkeri kahal.
Peshita: merubbin venitmaatu – hayeynu pelugeta derabbi shimon verabbanan.
Muatin venitrabbu, may? mi peligi rabbi shimon verabbanan? rabbi shimon deazel batar yedia mechayyayv, verabbanan deazli batar chattat – patri [o la], may?
Vetisbera? emor deshamat leh lerabbi shimon deazel af batar yedia [hechi dehave yedia vachataa bechiyyuv], yedia dela chataa mi shamat leh?
Deim ken, layyte ki hasheta! ella, rabbi shimon chataa vidia bae.

Ibbaya lehu: horu bet din chelev muttar, veasu miut hakkahal, vechazru bet din bahen, vehoru, veasu miut acher, mahu? kevan dishte yediot ninhu la mitztaref, o dilma: kevan deidde veidde chelev hu, mitztaref?

Veim timtza lomar: kevan deidde veidde chelev hu mitztaref, miut bechelev sheal gabbe hakkeva, umiut bechelev sheal gabbe dakkin, mahu? hacha vadday kevan devitre kerae kaate – la mitztaref, o dilma kevan deidde veidde chelev hu – mitztaref?

Veim timtze lomar: shem chelev hu umitztaref, miut bechelev umiut bedam, mahu? hacha vadday (kevan) ditre issure ninhu, [vechevan deen issuran shave] – la mitztaref, o dilma kevan (deissuran shave) – dekorbanan shave, mitztaref?

Veim timtze lomar: kevan (deissuran shave) dekorbanan shave mitztaref, miut bechelev umiut baavoda zara, mahu? hacha vadday en issuran shave veen korbanan shave, o dilma kevan deidde veidde karet hu, mitztaref? teku.
Ibbaya lehu: horu bet din shechelev muttar, veasu miut hakkahal, umet oto bet din veamad bet din acher, vechazru vehoru, veasu miut acher.
Allibba deman deamar bet din mayyte – la tibbee lach, deha letanhu, ella ki tibbee lach – allibba deman deamar tzibbur mayyte, may tzibbur? ha kae,
b: O dilma [yedia] dehahu bet din dehoru bainan! teku.

Amar rabbi yonatan: mea sheyyashvu lehorot – en chayyayvin ad sheyyoru kullan, shenneemar: "veim kol adat yisrael yishgu", ad sheyyishgu kullan [ad shettifshot horaa bechol adat yisrael] amar rav huna bereh derav hoshaya: hachi name mistabbera, divchol hattora kullah kayyma lan rubbo kechullo, vehacha ketiv "kol haeda" – hoil vechach, afillu hen mea.

[Tenan:] horu bet din, veyada echad mehen shettau, o talmid verauy lehoraa, vehalach veasa al pihem, ben sheasu veasa immahen, uven sheasu veasa acharehen, uven shello asu veasa – hare ze chayyayv, mippene shello tala bevet din.
Hay hu dechayyayv, ha acher patur, veammay? ha lo nigmera horaa! hacha bemay askinan? kegon shehirkin hahu echad mehen berosho.

Ta shema: horu bet din, veyada echad mehen shettau veamar lahen "toin attem" – hare ellu peturim. tama deamar lahen "toin attem" – difturim, ha shatek mishtak – chayyayvin, vegamar la horaa, veammay? veha lo horu kullan! amri: hachi name kegon shehirkin berosho.

Metiv rav mesharsheya: samchu rabbotenu al divre rabban shimon ben gamliel veal divre rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok, shehayu omrim: en gozrin gezera al hatztzibbur ella im ken rov hatztzibbur yecholin laamod bah,
Veamar rav adda bar abba: may kera? "bammeera attem nearim veoti attem kovim haggoy kullo". veha hacha dichtiv "haggoy kullo", verubba kecholla dame, teyuveta derabbi (yochanan) [yonatan]. teyuveta.
Veella, may "kol adat" dekaamar rachamana? hachi kaamar: i ikka kullam – havya horaa, vei la – la havya horaa.
Amar rabbi yehoshua: asara sheyyoshvin baddin – kolar taluy betzavvar kullan. peshita! ha ka mashma lan daafillu talmid bifne rabbo.

Rav huna ki hava nafek leve dina, mayyti asara tannae deve rav lekammeh, ki hechi denimteyayn shibba mikkeshura. rav ashe ki havo mayyti terefta lekammeh, mayyte asara tabbache mimmata machseya umotev kammeh, amar: ki hecha denimteyayn shibba mikkeshura.

Mishna horu bet din veyadu shettau vechazru bahen, ben sheheviu kapparatan uven shello heviu kapparatan, vehalach veasa al pihen – rabbi shimon poter, verabbi elazar omer: safek. ezehu safek? yashav lo betoch beto – chayyayv, halach lo limdinat hayyam – patur.
Amar rabbi akiva: mode ani baze shehu karov liftur min hachova. amar lo ben azzay: may shena ze min hayyoshev beveto? shehayyoshev beveto efshar haya lo sheyyishma, veze lo haya lo efshar sheyyishma.
Horu bet din laakor et kol hagguf, amru: en nidda battora, en shabbat battora, en avoda zara battora – hare ellu peturin. horu levattel miktzat ulekayyem miktzat – hare ellu chayyayvin.
Ketzad? amru: yesh nidda battora, aval habba al shomeret yom keneged yom – patur,
Yesh shabbat battora, aval hammotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim – patur,
Yesh avoda zara battora, aval hammishtachave – patur, hare ellu chayyayvin, shenneemar: "veneelam davar" – davar, velo kol hagguf.

Gemara amar rav yehuda amar rav: may tama derabbi shimon? hoil uvirshut bet din hu ose. ikka deamri: amar rav yehuda amar rav, omer haya rabbi shimon: kol horaa sheyyatza berov tzibbur – yachid haose otah patur, lefi shello nittena horaa ella lehavechin ben shogeg lemezid.
Metivi: par helem davar shel tzibbur useire avoda zara – battechilla govin alehen, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi yehuda omer: mitterumat hallishka hen bain. ammay, kevan degave lehu, have leh "hoda"!
Ibbaet ema: kegon sheggavu setam.
Veibbaet ema: kegon dela hava leh bemata.
Veibbaet ema: rav keiddach tanna savar, detanya ippecha: battechilla govin lahen, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: mitterumat hallishka hen bain.
Tane: rabbi meir mechayyev, verabbi shimon poter, rabbi elazar omer: safek, mishshum somchos amru: taluy. amar rabbi yochanan: asham taluy ikka benayyhu.
Amar rabbi zera: mashal derabbi elazar lamma haddavar dome? leadam sheachal safek chelev safek shumman, venoda lo, shemmevi asham.

a: Vela mibbaya leman deamar tzibbur mayyte, dimfarsema milleta. ella afillu leman deamar bet din meviin, dela mefarsema milleta – i hava shael, havo amrin leh.

Amar rabbi yose bar avin, veittema rabbi yose bar zevida: mashal desomchos lema haddavar dome? leadam shehevi kapparato ben hashshemashot, safek mibbeod yom nitkapper lo, safek mishshechashecha nitkapper lo, sheen mevi asham taluy.

Vela mibbaya leman deamar bet din meviin dela ipparsema milleta, ella afillu leman deamar tzibbur meviin, dimfarsema milleta, vahavo amrinan leh, dehacha besafek mibbeod yom safek mishshechashecha, i shael la ashkach inash dimshayyelleh.
Amar lo ben azzay: may shena min hayyoshev kulei. shappir kaamar leh rabbi akiva leven azzay?
Amar rava: hechzik badderech ikka benayyhu, leven azzay chayyayv – deha beveteh iteh, lerabbi akiva patur – deha hechzik badderech.

Horu lo bet din laakor et kol hagguf. tanu rabbanan: "veneelam davar" – velo sheyyeaker hammitzva kullah. ketzad? amru: en nidda battora, en shabbat battora, en avoda zara battora, yachol yehu chayyayvin? talmud lomar: "veneelam davar" – velo shettitallem mitzva kullah. hare ellu peturin.

Aval amru: yesh nidda battora aval habba al shomeret yom keneged yom patur, yesh shabbat battora aval hammotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim patur, yesh avoda zara battora aval hammishtachave patur – yachol yehu peturin? talmud lomar: "veneelam davar" velo kol hagguf.

Amar mar: yachol yehu peturin. vei bekiyyum miktzat uvittul miktzat peturin, uvaakirat kol hagguf peturin – bemay chayyayvin? tanna hachi ka kashya leh, ema: "davar" kulla milleta mashma! talmud lomar: "veneelam davar".
May mashma? amar ulla: keri beh "veneelam middavar".
Chizkiyya amar, amar kera: "veasu achat mikkol mitzvot", "mikkol mitzvot" – velo kol mitzvot. mitzvot tarte mashma! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: "mitzvat" ketiv.

Rav ashe amar: yalef "davar" "davar" mizzaken mamre, dichtiv beh bezaken mamre: "ki yippale mimmecha davar... lo tasur min haddavar asher yaggidu lecha yamin usemol", ma mamre – "min haddavar" velo kol davar, af behoraa – "davar" velo kol hagguf.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: en bet din chayyayvin ad sheyyoru bedavar sheen hatztzaddukin modin bo. aval bedavar shehatztzaddukin modin bo – peturin. may tama? zil keri be rav hu.
Tenan: yesh nidda battora, aval habba al shomeret yom keneged yom patur. veammay? shomeret yom keneged yom, ha ketiv "vesafra lah", melammed shessoferet echad leechad!
Deamri: haaraa sharya, gemar bia hu daasira. ha name ketiv: "et mekorah heera"!
Deamri: kedarkah – asira, shello kedarkah – sharya. ha ketiv: "mishkeve ishsha"!
Deamri: kedarkah – asur afillu haaraa, beshello kedarkah – gemar bia hu deasur, aval haaraa sharya. i hachi, afillu nidda name!
Ella leolam kedarkah, udeamri: haaraa beishsha dava hu dichtiva. veibbaet ema, deamri: zava la havya ella bimame, dichtiv: "kol yeme zovah".
Tenan: yesh shabbat battora, aval hammotzi mershut lirshut patur. veammay? hotzaa ha ketiva: "lo totziu massa mibbattechem"!
[Deamri hotzaa hu deasur, hachenasa muttar. veibbaet ema], deamri: hotzaa vehachenasa hu daasira, moshit vezorek shere.
Tenan: yesh avoda zara battora, aval hammishtachave patur. veammay? hammishtachave ha ketiva, dichtiv: "lo tishtachave leel acher"!

Deamri: ki asira hishtachavaya kedarkah, aval shello kedarkah – sharya. veibbaet ema, deamri: hishtachavaya gufa kedarkah hu daasir, deit ba pishshut yadayim veraglayim, ha hishtachavaya delet ba pishshut yadayim veraglayim – sharya.
b: Bae rav yosef: en charisha beshabbat, mahu? mi amrinan: kevan deka modu bechullehu milleta, kevittul miktzat vekiyyum miktzat dame, o dilma: kevan deka akriyin leh lacharishah kol ikkar, kaakirat guf dame?
Ta shema: yesh nidda battora aval habba al shomeret yom keneged yom patur. veammay? ha akriyin leshomeret yom keneged yom kol ikkar!
Amar lecha rav yosef: shomeret yom dekaamrin kidshannin.
Ta shema: yesh shabbat battora, aval hammotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim patur. veammay? ha akriyin lehotzaa kol ikkar!
Hatam name kidshannin.
Ta shema: yesh avoda zara battora, aval hammishtachave patur. ammay? veha akriyin lehishtachavaya kol ikkar!
Amri: hishtachavaya name kidshannin.
Bae rabbi zera: en shabbat bashsheviit, mahu? bemay tau? behaden kera: "becharish uvakkatzir tishbot", bizman deikka charisha – ikka shabbat, uvizman delekka charisha – lekka shabbat.
Mi amrinan: kevan dimkayyeymin la bishar shene shavua, kevittul miktzat vekiyyum miktzat dame, o dilma: kevan deka akriyin leh bishviit, kaakirat hagguf dame?

Amar ravina, ta shema: navi shennitnabbe laakor davar middivre tora – chayyayv. levittul miktzat ulekiyyum miktzat, rabbi shimon omer: patur. uvaavoda zara, afillu amar: hayyom ovdah, ulemachar battela – chayyayv, shema minna: en shabbat bashsheviit kevittul miktzat vekiyyum miktzat dame. shema minna.

Mishna horu bet din, veyada echad mehen shettau, veamar lahen: "toin attem", o shello haya mufela shel bet din sham, o shehaya echad mehen ger o mamzer o natin, o zaken shello rauy levanim – hare ze patur.
Shenneemar kan "eda", veneemar lehallan "eda", me "eda" haamura lehallan – kullan reuyin lehoraa, af "eda" haamura kan – ad sheyyihyu kullan reuyin lehoraa.

Gemara o shello haya mufela shel bet din sham – menalan? amar rav sheshet, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael: mippene ma amru horu bedavar shehatztzaddukin modin bo peturin? mippene shehaya lahem lilmod velo lamdu, lo haya mufela shel bet din sham name peturin, mippene shehaya lahem lilmod velo lamdu.
Neemar sham "eda" veneemar kan "eda", ad sheyyehu kullan reuyin lehoraa. vehatam menalan? deamar rav chisda amar kera: "vehityatztzevu sham immach" – "immach" bedomin lach.
Veema: "immach" lishchina! ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, amar kera: "venasu ittach" – "ittach" bedomin lach.
Mishna horu bet din shoggin, veasu kol hakkahal shoggin – meviin par. mezidin, veasu shoggin – meviin kisba useira. shoggin, veasu mezidin – hare ellu peturin.
Gemara shoggin veasu mezidin – hare ellu peturin. ha shogeg dumeya demezid – chayyayv, vehechi dame? shehoru bet din shechelev muttar, venitchallef lo beshumman vaachalo.
Lema, tifshot ha devae rame bar chama! amar lach, mishshum ditna resha: mezidin veasu shoggin, tena sefa: shoggin veasu mezidin.

Mishna horu bet din veasu kol hakkahal o rubban al pihen – meviin par. uvaavoda zara – meviin par vesair, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: shenem asar shevatim – meviin shenem asar parim. uvaavoda zara – meviin shenem asar parim ushenem asar seirim.

a: Rabbi shimon omer: shelosha asar parim, uvaavoda zara – shelosha asar parim ushelosha asar seirim, par vesair lechol shevet veshevet, par vesair levet din.

Horu bet din veasu shiva shevatim o rubban al pihen – meviin par, uvaavoda zara – meviin par vesair, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: shiva shevatim shechatu – meviin shiva parim, ushear shevatim shello chatu – meviin al yedehen par, sheaf ellu shello chatu meviin al yede chotin. rabbi shimon omer: shemona parim, uvaavoda zara – shemona parim ushemona seirim, par vesair lechol shevet veshevet, par vesair levet din.

Horu bet din shel echad min hashshevatim, veasa oto hashshevet al pihen – oto shevet hu chayyayv, ushear kol hashshevatim peturin, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: en chayyayvin ella al horayot bet din haggadol bilvad, shenneemar: "veim kol adat yisrael yishgu", velo adat oto shevet.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: yadu shehoru, vetau ma horu, yachol yehu chayyayvin? talmud lomar: "venoda hachattat", velo sheyyivvadu hachotin.

"Asher chatu", chatu shene shevatim – meviin shene farim, chatu shelosha – meviin shelosha, o eno omer ella chatu shene yechidim – meviin shene farim, chatu shelosha – meviin shelosha? talmud lomar: "hakkahal", hakkahal chayyayv, vechol kahal vekahal chayyayv, ketzad? chatu shene shevatim – meviin shene farim, chatu shiva – meviin shiva, ushear shevatim shello chatu – meviin al yedehen par par, sheafillu ellu shello chatu meviin al yede hachotin, lechach neemar "kahal" lechayyev al kol kahal vekahal. divre rabbi yehuda.

Rabbi shimon omer: shiva shevatim shechatu – meviin shiva parim, uvet din meviin al yedehen par, shenneemar lematta "kahal" veneemar lemala "kahal". ma "kahal" haamur lemala – bet din im hakkahal, af "kahal" haamur lematta – bet din im hakkahal.

Rabbi meir omer: shiva shevatim shechatu – bet din meviin al yedehem par, vehen peturin, neemar "kahal" lematta veneemar "kahal" lemala, ma "kahal" haamur lemala – bet din velo tzibbur, af "kahal" haamur lematta – bet din velo tzibbur.
Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshemo: chatu shishsha shevatim vehem rubbo shel kahal, o shiva af al pi sheeno rubbo shel kahal – meviin par.
Amar mar: "venoda hachattat" – velo sheyyivvadu hachotin. man tanna? amar rav yehuda amar rav, veittema rava: dela kerabbi eliezer. ditnan,
Amar rabbi eliezer: ma nafshach? im chelev achal – chayyayv, notar achal – chayyayv.
Rav ashe amar: afillu tema rabbi eliezer, shane hacha, dichtiv: "asher chatu aleha". hatam name hachtiv: "asher chata bah"! hahu mibbee leh: perat lammitassek.
May tama derabbi yehuda? kasavar: arbaa kehale ketivi – "kahal", "hakkahal", "kahal", "hakkahal".
Chad lechayyev al kol kahal vekahal, vechad lehoraa teluya bevet din umaase taluy bakkahal. vechad ligrira. vechad leshevet sheasa behoraat bet din.
Verabbi shimon telata kehale ketivi: "hakkahal", "kahal", "hakkahal". "meene hakkahal" orcheh dikra hu, kidamri inashe: meene diflanya.
Chad lechayyev al kol kahal vekahal, utere acharine: neemar lematta "kahal" veneemar lemala "kahal", ma lehallan bet din im hakkahal – af kan bet din im hakkahal.
Verabbi meir, "kahal" "hakkahal" la daresh, hilkach tere kehale ketivi. mibbee leh: leneemar lematta "kahal" veneemar lemala "kahal", ma lehallan bet din velo tzibbur – af kan bet din velo tzibbur.
Verabbi shimon ben elazar may tama? ketiv: "vehaya im meene haeda" – alma miuta, dichtiv: "meene". uchetiv: "ki lechol haam bishgaga", lememra derubba – in, miuta – la.
Ha ketzad? asu shishsha vehen rubbo shel kahal, o shiva af al pi sheenan rubbo shel kahal – chayyayvin.
b: Verabbi shimon verabbi meir, dehoraa teluya bevet din umaase taluy bakkahal, mena lehu? amar abbaye, deamar kera: "vehaya im meene haeda neesta lishgaga". rava amar: "millechol haam bishgaga".

Utzericha, dei ketav rachamana "vehaya im meene haeda neesta lishgaga", hava amena: afillu miuta, lehachi ketiv "lechol haam bishgaga". vei ketav "lechol haam bishgaga", hava amena: ad deavdi bet din bahade rubba, lehachi ketiv "vehaya im meene haeda neesta lishgaga".
Veha ki ketivi hane kerae baavoda zara hu dichtivi. yalfinan "meene" "meene".

Horu bet din shel echad vechulei. ibbaya lehu: shevet echad lerabbi yehuda behoraat bet din haggadol, mi mayytu shear shevatim o la? mi amrinan: shiva shevatim hu demayytu shear shevatim bahadayyhu, mishshum deikka rubba, aval chad shevet, delekka rubba – la, o dilma la shena!

Ta shema: ma hen meviin? par echad, rabbi shimon omer: shene farim. bemay askinan? ilema shechatu shiva, rabbi shimon temanya bae! ella dechata shevet echad. bemay? i behoraat bet dino, rabbi shimon let leh! ella lav behoraat bet din haggadol.
Vetanna kamma manni? i nema rabbi meir, ha rubba bae! ella lav rabbi yehuda, uchegon shechata shevet echad.

Amri, hacha bemay askinan? kegon shechatu shishsha shevatim vehen rubban shel kahal, verabbi shimon ben elazar hi. detanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshemo: chatu shishsha vehen rubbo shel kahal, o shiva af al pi sheenan rubbo shel kahal – meviin par.
Ta shema, rabbi yehuda omer: shevet sheasa behoraat bet dino – oto hashshevet chayyayv, ushear kol hashshevatim peturin. uvehoraat bet din haggadol – afillu shear shevatim chayyayvim. shema minna.

Amar rav ashe: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: veasa oto hashshevet al pihem – oto hashshevet chayyayv ushear kol hashshevatim peturin. lema li lemitna ushear shevatim peturim? ha tena oto hashshevet chayyayv, vechevan ditna oto hashshevet chayyayv, mimmela yadana shear shevatim peturin! ella ha kamashma lan, behoraat bet dino hu dishar shevatim peturim, aval behoraat bet din haggadol – afillu shear shevatim chayyayvin. shema minna.
Ibbaya lehu: shevet echad sheasa behoraat bet din haggadol, lerabbi shimon mi mayyte o la?

Ta shema: ma hen meviin? par echad, rabbi shimon omer: shene farim. bemay askinan? ilema shechatu shiva – shene farim? shemona parim bae! ella dechata shevet echad, uvemay? ilema behoraat bet dino, rabbi shimon let leh! ella behoraat bet din haggadol.
Vetisbera: tanna kamma manni? i rabbi meir – ha rubba bae, i rabbi yehuda – shear shevatim name mayytu! ella ha manni – rabbi shimon ben elazar hi, vechidtanya.
Ta shema, vachachamim omrim: leolam eno chayyayv ella al horaat bet din haggadol. man chachamim? ilema rabbi meir, rubba bae! ella lav, rabbi shimon hi! shema minna.

Verabbi yehuda verabbi shimon, shevet echad deikkeri kahal mena lehu? amri, dichtiv: "vayyaamod yehoshafat bikhal yehuda virushalaym (nachach chatzar bet Adonai) [bevet Adonai lifne hechatzer] hachadasha". may "chadasha"? amar rabbi yochanan, shechiddeshu devarim veamru: tevul yom, al yikkanes bemachane leviyya.

Matkef la rav acha bar yaakov: mimmay? dilma shane yerushalayim, dahava name binyamin! ella amar rav acha bar yaakov, dichtiv: "vayyomer elay hinni mafrecha vehirbiticha unetatticha likhal ammim vegomer" man ityelid leh hahi shata? binyamin, shema minna hachi kaamar rachamana: mityelid lach hasheta kahal acharina.

Amar leh rav shabba lerav kahana, dilma hachi kaamar leh rachamana: lechi mityelid lach binyamin, hu dehavu shenem asar shevatim demitkaryayt kahal! amar leh: ella shenem asar shevatim ikkeru kahal, achad asar shevatim lo ikkeru kahal?

Tanya rabbi shimon omer: ma talmud lomar: "ufar sheni ven bakar tikkach lechattat"? im lelammed shehem shenayim, vahalo kevar neemar: "vaase et haechad chattat veet haechad ola laAdonai"! [ella] yachol [tehe] neechelet chattat lalviyyim? talmud lomar: "ufar sheni" – sheni laola, ma ola la neechelet,

a: Af chattat lo neechelet.

Kayyotze bo, amar rabbi yose: "habbaim mehashshevi haggola hikrivu [olot] lelohe yisrael parim shenem asar vegomer hakkol ola". hakkol ola salka datach? efshar shechattat ola! ella hakkol kaola: ma ola lo neechelet – af chattat lo neechelet. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: al avoda zara hevium, veamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: al avoda zara sheasu bime tzidkiyyahu.

Bishlama lerabbi yehuda, mashkachat la lehane shenem asar chattaot kegon dechatu shenem asar shevatim, demayytu shenem asar seirim. i name dechatu shiva shevatim usheara inach bigrira. ulerabbi shimon name mashkachat la, kegon dechatu achad asar shevatim, demayytu achad asar seirim veiddach devet din. ella lerabbi meir deamar: bet din meviin velo tzibbur, shenem asar hechi mashkachat leh? kegon dechatu vahadar chatu vahadar chatu, ad teresar zimne.
Veha mayyte lehu hanhu dechatu!

Amar rav pappa: ki gemiri chattat shemmetu bealeha bemita – hane mille beyachid, aval lo betzibbur, lefi sheen mita betzibbur. mena leh lerav pappa ha? illema middichtiv: "tachat avotecha yihyu vanecha", i hachi afillu beyachid name!

Ella dukeya derav pappa missair derosh chodesh, deamar rachamana: mayyte mitterumat hallishka. veha mayyte lehu miyyisrael, vehanach defayyshi hechi mayytu! ella shema minna: chattat shemmetu bealeha betzibbur kereva.

Mi dame? sair derosh chodesh, dilma la mayytu mitztzibbur, aval hacha vadday mayytu! ella tama derav pappa mehacha, dichtiv: "kapper leammecha yisrael asher padita Adonai" – reuya kappara zo shettechapper al yotze mitzrayim, middichtiv: "asher padita".
Mi dame? hatam, kullehu itinun miggo dimchappera achayyim, mechappera name ammetim. ella hacha mi havo chayyim? in, hachi name, dichtiv: "verabbim mehakkohanim vehaleviyyim verashe haavot vegomer".
Vedilma muatin havo vela rabbim havo! hachtiv: "(velo hikkiru bekol) [veen haam makkirim kol] teruat hassimcha lekol bechi haam [vegomer] vehakkol nishma ad lemerachok".
Veha mezidin havo! horaat shaa hayta. hachi name mistabbera, dei la tema hachi – "elim tishim veshishsha kevasim shivim veshiva", keneged mi? ella horaat shaa hayta, hacha name horaat shaa hayta.

Tanu rabbanan: met echad min hatztzibbur – chayyayvin, echad mibbet din – peturin. man tanna? amar rav chisda amar rabbi zera amar rav yirmeya amar rav, rabbi meir hi, deamar: bet din meviim velo tzibbur, hilkach met echad min hatztzibbur – chayyayvin, deha kaem kulleh bet din, met echad mibbet din – peturin, dehavya la chattat shemmet echad min hashshuttafin, umishshum hachi peturin.

Matkef la rav yosef: venokma kerabbi shimon, deamar: bet din im hatztzibbur, met echad min hatztzibbur – chayyayvin, deen tzibbur metim. met echad mibbet din – peturin, kidamrinan dechattat shuttafin hi!

Amar leh abbaye, shaminan leh lerabbi shimon deamar: chattat shuttafin enah meta, detanya: par vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheavdu, vehifrish acherim tachtehem – yamutu kullan, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omer: yiru, lefi sheen chattat tzibbur meta.
Amar leh rav yosef: kohanim ka amrat? shane kohanim, deikkeru kahal, dichtiv: "al hakkohanim veal kol am hakkahal yechapper".
b: Ella meatta nayyto par behoraa! vechi tema, hachi name – tafi lehu shevatim.

Ella amar rav acha berabbi yaakov: shivto shel levi la ikkeru kahal, dichtiv: "hinni mafrecha vehirbiticha unetatticha likhal ammim vegomer". kol sheyyesh lo achuzza – ikkeri kahal, vechol sheen lo achuzza – la ikkeri kahal.

Im ken, chasri lehu shenem asar shevatim! amar abbaye: "efrayim umenashshe kiruven veshimon yihyu li". amar rava, veha ketiv: "al shem achehem yikkaru benachalatam", lenachala hukeshu velo ledavar acher!
Vela? veha chalukin baddegalim! kenachalatan kach chaniyyaytan, kede lechallek kavod laddegalim.
Veha chalukim bannesiim! hahu, lachalok kavod lannesiim. detanya: shelomo asa shiva yeme chanukka, uma raa moshe laasot shenem asar yeme chanukka? kede lachalok kavod lannesiim.
May have ala?

Ta shema, detanya: rabbi shimon omer, chamesh chattaot metot: velad chattat, utemurat chattat, vechattat shemmetu bealeha, vechattat shennitkapperu bealeha, vechattat sheavra shenatah. vei atta yachol lomar velad chattat betzibbur, sheen tzibbur mafrishin nekeva. vei atta yachol lomar temurat chattat betzibbur, sheen temura betzibbur. vei atta yachol lomar chattat shemmetu bealeha betzibbur, sheen tzibbur metim.

Shennitkapperu bealeha vesheavra shenatah – lo shamanu, yachol yamutu? amarta: yilmod satum min hameforash, ma matzinu bivlad chattat utemurat chattat veshemmetu bealeha – beyachid devarim amurim velo betzibbur, af shennitkapperu bealeha vesheavra shenatah – beyachid devarim amurim velo betzibbur.
Vechi danin efshar mishshei efshar? rabbi shimon bechad makom gemir.
Haderan alach horu bet din
Mishna hora kohen mashiach leatzmo shogeg veasa shogeg – mevi par. shogeg veasa mezid, mezid veasa shogeg – patur, shehoraat kohen mashiach leatzmo kehoraat bet din latztzibbur.
Gemara shogeg veasa shogeg – mevi par. peshita!

Amar abbaye: hacha bemay askinan? kegon shehora, veshachach meeze taam hora, uveshaa shettaa amar: hareni ose al daat horaato, demahu detema: kevan deillu mityeda leh, [shemma] hadar beh – kemezid dame vela lichayyayv, ka mashma lan.
Mezid veasa shogeg kulei. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "leashmat haam", hare mashiach ketzibbur. sheyyachol, vahalo din hu:

a: Tzibbur mutza mikkelal yachid, umashiach mutza mikkelal yachid. ma tzibbur en chayyayvin ella al helem davar im shiggat maase, af mashiach lo yehe chayyayv ella al helem davar im shiggat maase.
O kelach lederech zo: nasi mutza mikkelal yachid, umashiach mutza mikkelal yachid. ma nasi mevi beshiggat maase belo helem davar, af mashiach mevi beshiggat maase belo helem davar!

Nire lemi dome? tzibbur – befar veen meviin asham taluy, umashiach – befar veen mevi asham taluy. ma tzibbur eno chayyayv ella al helem davar im shiggat maase, af mashiach lo yehe chayyayv ella al helem davar im shiggat maase.
O kelach lederech zo: nasi mevi seira baavoda zara umevi asham vadday, umashiach mevi seira baavoda zara umevi asham vadday. ma nasi mevi beshiggat maase, af mashiach mevi beshiggat maase.
Talmud lomar: "leashmat haam", hare hu mashiach ketzibbur. ma tzibbur eno mevi ella al helem davar im shiggat maase, af mashiach eno mevi ella al helem davar im shiggat maase.

Ema: ma tzibbur hora veasu acharav behoraato – chayyayvin, af mashiach keshehora veasu acharav behoraato – yehe chayyayv! talmud lomar: "vehikriv al chattato asher chata", al ma shechata hu mevi, veen mevi al ma shechatu acherim.
Amar mar: mashiach befar veen mevi asham taluy. mena leh deen mevi asham taluy?
Dichtiv: "vechipper alav hakkohen al shiggato asher shagag", mi shechattato veshiggato shava, yatza mashiach sheen shiggato vechattato shava, dichtiv: "leashmat haam", hare hu mashiach ketzibbur.
"Leashmat haam", ad kan la kaamar leh. ella asham kedi nasva.

Mishna hora bifne atzmo veasa bifne atzmo – mitkapper lo bifne atzmo. hora im hatztzibbur veasa im hatztzibbur – mitkapper lo im hatztzibbur, sheen bet din chayyayvin ad sheyyoru levattel miktzat ulekayyem miktzat, vechen hammashiach, velo baavoda zara ad sheyyoru levattel miktzat ulekayyem miktzat.
Gemara menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: hora im hatztzibbur veasa im hatztzibbur, yachol yavi par leatzmo?

Vedin hu: nasi mutza mikkelal yachid umashiach mutza mikkelal yachid, ma nasi, chata bifne atzmo – mevi bifne atzmo, chata im hatztzibbur – mitkapper lo im hatztzibbur. af mashiach, chata bifne atzmo – mevi bifne atzmo, chata im hatztzibbur – mitkapper lo im hatztzibbur!
Lo, im amarta benasi – shekken mitkapper lo im hatztzibbur beyom hakkippurim. tomar bemashiach – sheen mitkapper lo im hatztzibbur beyom hakkippurim!

Hoil veen mitkapper lo im hatztzibbur beyom hakkippurim, yachol yavi par leatzmo? talmud lomar: "al chattato asher chata", ha ketzad? chata bifne atzmo – mevi bifne atzmo, chata im hatztzibbur – mitkapper lo im hatztzibbur.

Hechi dame? illema dehu mufela vehem enan mufelain, peshita demitkapper lo bifne atzmo, horaa dilhon velo kelum. uvae etoye kisba o seira kol chad vechad! vei deinnun mufelain vehu lav mufela, ammay mitkapper lo bifne atzmo? ha horaa dideh velo kelum hi.
b: Amar rav pappa: kegon shehayu mufelin shenehen.

Savar abbaye lememar: chata bifne atzmo veasa bifne atzmo hechi dame? deyatvi bishne mekomot veka moru bitre issure, amar leh rava: attu shene mekomot gormin? ella afillu yatvi bechad makom, vechevan deka moru bitre issure – chata bifne atzmo hu.

Peshita: hu bechelev vehen baavoda zara – chata bifne atzmo hu, deha chalukin betamayyhu, vachalukin bekorbanot. dehu befar, vehen befar vesair – deha ka mayytu hane sair, vehu la mayyte. vechol shekken hu baavoda zara vehen bechelev, dachalukin bekorbenotehen [ligmare] – dehu seira, veinhu par,

Ella hu bechelev hamechasse et hakkerev, vehen bechelev sheal haddakkin, mahu? mi amrinan: af al gav dekorbanan shave, kevan demittere kerae kaatu, ha peligin betamayyhu, o dilma shem chelev echad hu?
Im timtza lomar shem chelev echad hu, hu bechelev vehen bedam, mahu? mi amrinan: betamayyhu ha peligin, o dilma kevan deshavin bekorban batar korban azlinan? teku.

Sheen bet din chayyayvin ad sheyyoru levattel miktzat ulekayyem miktzat vechulei. menalan dead sheyyoru levattel miktzat ulekayyem miktzat? kidamrinan beiddach pirkin: "veneelam davar" – "davar" – velo kol hagguf.
Vechen hammashiach. menalan? dichtiv: "leashmat haam", hare mashiach ketzibbur.
Velo baavoda zara kulei. menalan? detanu rabbanan: lefi sheyyatza avoda zara ladun beatzmah, yachol yehu chayyayvin al akirat mitzva kullah?
Neemar kan "meene", veneemar lehallan "meene". ma lehallan bevet din, af kan name bevet din. uma lehallan "davar" velo kol hagguf, af kan name "davar" velo kol hagguf.
Mishna en chayyayvin ella al helem davar im shiggat hammaase, vechen hammashiach, velo baavoda zara – en chayyayvin ella al helem davar im shiggat hammaase.
Gemara menalan? detanu rabbanan: "yishgu" – yachol yehu chayyayvin al shiggat maase? talmud lomar: "yishgu veneelam davar", en chayyayvin ella al helem davar im shiggat maase.
Vechen hammashiach. menalan? dichtiv: "leashmat haam", hare mashiach ketzibbur.
Velo baavoda zara ella al helem davar im shiggat maase. menalan?

Detanu rabbanan: lefi sheyyatza avoda zara ladun beatzmah, yachol yehu chayyayvin al shiggat hammaase? neemar kan "meene" veneemar lehallan "meene", ma lehallan en chayyayvin ella al helem davar im shiggat maase, af kan en chayyayvin ella al helem davar im shiggat maase.
Veillu mashiach baavoda zara la katane, matnitin manni? rabbi hi.
Detanya: mashiach baavoda zara – rabbi omer: beshiggat maase. vachachamim omrim: behelem davar. veshavin shebbisira, veshavin sheen mevi asham taluy.
Vetisbera: bizdono karet uveshiggato chattat mi katane?
Ella tane ha hu haddin leha. hacha name tena ha vehu haddin leha.

May tama derabbi? amar kera: "vechipper hakkohen al hannefesh hashshogeget becheta vishgaga". "hannefesh" – ze mashiach, "hashshogeget" – ze nasi, "becheta bishgaga" – rabbi savar: chet ze bishgaga yehe.
Verabbanan savri: mi shechattato bishgaga, yatza mashiach sheen chattato bishgaga ella behelem davar.
Veshavin shebbisira keyachid. menalan? deamar kera: "veim nefesh achat" – echad yachid veechad nasi veechad mashiach – kullam bichlal "nefesh achat" hen.

a: Veshavin sheen mevi asham taluy. menalan? dichtiv: "vechipper [alav] hakkohen al shiggato asher shagag". rabbi savar: mi shekkol cheto bishgaga, yatza ze sheen [kol] cheto bishgaga, ella behelem davar.

Midde "kol" ketiv? in deim ken nichtov "al shiggato". lema li "asher shagag" ha ka mashma lan dead deikka kol cheto bishgaga. yatza mashiach sheen kol cheto bishgaga ella baavoda zara, velo bishar mitzvot ella behelem davar im shiggat maase.
Verabbanan: mi shecheto bishgaga, yatza mashiach, sheen cheto bishgaga lo baavoda zara velo bishar mitzvot, ella behelem davar im shiggat maase.
Mishna en bet din chayyayvin ad sheyyoru bedavar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat, vechen hammashiach, velo baavoda zara – ad sheyyoru al davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat.
Gemara minnalan?
Detanya, rabbi omer: neemar kan "aleha" veneemar lehallan "aleha". ma lehallan – davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat, af kan – davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat.
Ashkechan tzibbur, mashiach menalan? "leashmat haam", hare mashiach ketzibbur.

Nasi? yalef "mitzvot" "mitzvot", ketiv gabbe nasi: "veasa achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai", uchetiv betzibbur: "veasu achat mikkol mitzvot" – ma tzibbur – davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat, af nasi – davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat.
Yachid? amar kera: "veim nefesh", veyilmad tachton meelyon.
Velo baavoda zara ad sheyyoru. baavoda zara menalan? detanu rabbanan: lefi sheyyatza avoda zara ladun beatzmah, yachol yehu chayyayvin afillu al davar sheen zedono karet veshiggato chattat?
Neemar kan "meene", veneemar lehallan "meene". ma lehallan davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat, af kan davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat.
Ashkechan tzibbur. yachid, nasi, mashiach menalan? amar kera: "veim nefesh achat", echad yachid veechad nasi veechad mashiach kullan bichlal "nefesh achat" hen, veyilmad tachton min haelyon.
Hanicha leman demappek la lealeha" ligzera shava, kedaamaran. ella lerabbanan demappeki la lealeha" laarayot vetzarot, davar shezzedono karet veshiggato chattat – mena lehu?

Nafka lehu middematne leh rabbi yehoshua ben levi livreh: "tora achat yihye lachem laose bishgaga vehannefesh asher taase beyad rama vegomer" – hukkesha kol hattora kullah laavoda zara. ma avoda zara shechayyayvin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat, af kan shechayyayvin al zedono karet veal shiggato chattat.
Ashkechan yachid, nasi, umashiach, ben baavoda zara ben bishar mitzvot. tzibbur menalan? yalef elyon mittachton.

Verabbi, ha derabbi yehoshua ben levi may aved leh? mappek leh, lechidtanya: lefi shemmatzinu shechillek hakkatuv ben rabbim lichidim – rabbim besayif umamonan aved, yechidim biskila umamonan palet, yachol nachlok bekorbenotehem? talmud lomar: "tora achat yihye vegomer".
Matkef la rav chilkiyya mehageronya: tama delo chalak hakkatuv. ha chalak, hava amena nachlok. may nayyte?

Nayyte par, tzibbur bishar mitzvot hu demayytu! nayyte par leola vesair lechattat, tzibbur baavoda zara hu demayytu! nayyte seir, nasi bishar mitzvot hu demayyte! nayyte seira, yachid name hayeynu korbano!
Allema la itzterich? salka datach amena: tzibbur mayyte par leola vesair lechattat, hane nayyte ippecha – par lechattat vesair leola. i name: tzarich veen lo takkana, ka mashma lan.

Dechulle alma mihat ki ketivi hane kerae – baavoda zara hu dichtivi, may mashma? amar rava, vei tema rabbi yehoshua ben levi, veamri la kedi. amar kera: "vechi tishgu velo taasu et kol hammitzvot haelle", ezo hi mitzva shehi shekula kechol hammitzvot? heve omer: zo avoda zara.

Deve rabbi tana, amar kera: "asher dibber Adonai el moshe", uchetiv: "asher tzivva Adonai alechem beyad moshe", ezo hi mitzva shehi bedibburo shel hakkadosh baruch hu vetzivva al yede moshe? heve omer: zo avoda zara. detana rabbi yishmael: "anochi" velo yihye lecha" mippi haggevura shemanum.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana:
b: "Lemin hayyom asher tzivva Adonai vahala ledorotechem", ezo hi mitzva shehi neemra bitchilla? heve omer: zo avoda zara. veha amar mar: eser mitzvot nitztauu yisrael bemara (dichtiv: "vehaya im shamoa tishma lekol Adonai elohecha")? ella mechavvavrta chidshanninan meikkara.
Mishna en chayyayvin al ase veal lo taase shebbammikdash, veen meviin asham taluy al ase veal lo taase shebbammikdash.
Aval chayyayvin al ase veal lo taase shebbannidda, umeviim asham taluy al ase veal lo taase shebbannidda. ezo hi mitzvat ase shebbannidda? perosh min hannidda. umitzvat lo taase? al tavo al hannidda.
Gemara mena hane mille detzibbur la mechayyeyvi korban bealma, veyachid asham taluy name la?
Amar rav yitzchak bar avdimi: neemar "veashem" bechattat uveasham taluy, veneemar "veashemu" betzibbur. ma "veashem" beyachid – bechattat kevua, af "veashemu" betzibbur – bechattat kevua,

Uma tzibbur bechattat kevua, af asham taluy name en ba ella al sefek chattat kevua. amri: i hachi, korban ole veyored name, ha ketiv: "vehaya ki yesham leachat meelle"! danin ("ashem" min "ashemu") ["ashemu" min "ashem"], veen danin "ashem" min "yesham".
Umay nafka minna? veha tane deve rabbi yishmael: "veshav hakkohen" uva hakkohen" – zo hi shiva, zo hi bia! veod: nelaf min "veashem" mittumeat mikdash vekadashav, dichtiv: "vehu tame veashem"!
Amar rav pappa: danin "veashem" umitzvot Adonai" min "veashem" umitzvot Adonai". amar leh rav shimi bar ashe lerav pappa: venelaf "veashem" unesiat avon min "veashem" unesiat avon!

Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: danin "veashem" umitzvot Adonai asher lo teasena" – mivashem umitzvot Adonai asher lo teasena". veal yochiach shemiat kol uvittuy sefatayim vetumeat mikdash vekadashav, shello neemar bahem "veashem" umitzvot Adonai asher lo teasena".

Mishna en chayyayvin al shemiat kol, veal bittuy sefatayim, veal tumeat mikdash vekadashav. vehannasi kayyotze bahem, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer: hannasi chayyayv bechullan chutz mishshemiat hakkol, shehammelech lo dan velo danin oto [lo meid velo meidin oto].

Gemara amar ulla: may tama derabbi yose haggelili? amar kera: "vehaya chi yesham leachat meelle", kol shemmitchayyev beachat – mitchayyev bechullan, vesheen mitchayyev beachat – en mitchayyev bechullan.
Veema: mitchayyev beachat mehen, veaf al pi sheen mitchayyev bechullan!
Ella tama derabbi yose haggelili mehacha, detanya, haya rabbi yirmeya omer: neemar

a: "Lo taggia yado", veneemar "lo tassig yado" – mi shebba lide aniyyut vaashirut. yatza nasi umashiach, sheen bain lide aniyyut,

Nasi – dichtiv: "veasa achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai elohav". mi sheen al gabbav ella Adonai elohav. mashiach – dichtiv: "vehakkohen haggadol meechav", shehu gadol meechav benoy, bechoach, bechachma uveosher. acherim omrim: minnayin sheim en lo gaddelehu mishshel echav? talmud lomar: "vehakkohen haggadol meechav asher yutzak al rosho" – gaddelehu meechav.
Bea minneh ravina merav nachman bar yitzchak: nasi shennitztara, mahu? midcha deche, o miftar petir? amar leh: dilach, o degazza?
Tanya, rabbi akiva omer: mashiach patur mikkullan. amar rava: may tama derabbi akiva? amar kera: "ze korban aharon uvanav". zo baa chova lo, veen acheret baa chova lo.

Veema: ki memaet leh rachamana – middalle dallut, umay nihu? asirit haefa. aval aniyyut vaashirut, la maateh rachamana! la salka datach, dichtiv: "vechipper alav hakkohen al chattato asher chata meachat meelle". hammitkapper beachat – mitkapper bechullan, vesheen mitkapper beachat – en mitkapper bechullan.

Ella meatta, dichtiv: "vehaya ki yesham leachat meelle", hachi name: dechol hammitchayyev beachat – mitchayyev bechullan, vesheen mitchayyev beachat – en mitchayyev bechullan. allema tenan, rabbi akiva omer: nasi chayyayv chutz mishshemiat kol!
Abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: "meachat" mashma leh, "leachat" la mashma leh. umay shena "meachat" demashma leh?

Dechatveh rachamana levassof gabbe asirit haefa, lememra dechol demichayyayv baasirit haefa – michayyayv bechullan, dei salka datach mitchayyev beachat af al pi sheen mitchayyev bechullan, nichteveh lehay "meachat meelle" bedallut, i name baashirut.
