Mishna kol hammitzvot shebbetora shechayyayvin al zedonan karet veal shiggatan chattat – hayyachid mevi kisba useira, vehannasi sair, umashiach uvet din meviin par. uvaavoda zara – hayyachid vehannasi vehammashiach meviin seira, uvet din par vesair; par leola vesair lechattat.
Asham taluy – hayyachid vehannasi chayyayvin, umashiach uvet din peturin. asham vadday – hayyachid vehannasi vehammashiach chayyayvin, uvet din peturin.

Al shemiat hakkol, veal bittuy sefatayim, veal tumeat mikdash vekadashav – bet din peturin, vehayyachid vehannasi vehammashiach chayyayvin, ella sheen kohen gadol mashiach chayyayv al tumeat mikdash vekadashav, divre rabbi shimon. uma hen meviin? korban ole veyored. rabbi eliezer omer: hannasi mevi sair.

Gemara tanya, rabbi shimon haya noten kelal: kol shehayyachid beasham taluy – hannasi kayyotze bo, mashiach uvet din peturin. vechol shehu beasham vadday – nasi umashiach kayyotze bahen, uvet din peturin.

Shemiat hakkol, uvittuy sefatayim, vetumeat mikdash vekadashav – bet din peturin, nasi umashiach chayyayvin, ella sheen hannasi chayyayv bishmiat hakkol, velo mashiach betumeat mikdash vekadashav. kol shehu beole veyored – nasi kayyotze bo, mashiach uvet din peturin.

Ha gufa kashya, amrat: sheen mashiach chayyayv betumeat mikdash vekadashav, betumeat mikdash vekadashav – hu defatur, aval bishmiat hakkol uvittuy sefatayim – chayyayv. ema sefa: kol shehu beole veyored – nasi kayyotze bo, mashiach uvet din peturin, katane: mashiach uvet din peturin, ma bet din peturin mikkullehon – af mashiach patur mikkullehon.
b: Kashyayn ahadade!

Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: la kashya. kan – bedallut, kan – bedalle dallut. verabbi shimon savar la kerabbi akiva bachada ufelig aleh bachada: savar la kerabbi akiva bedalle dallut defatur, ufelig aleh bedallut.

Ella sheen kohen gadol chayyayv kulei. amar chizkiyya: may tama derabbi shimon? dichtiv: "venichreta hannefesh hahi mittoch hakkahal", mi shekkorbano shave lakkahal. yatza ze sheen korbano shave lakkahal.

Im ken, nasi name – en korbano shave lakkahal! shave bechappara deyom hakkippurim. im ken, kohanim name lo shavu lakkahal bechappara deyom hakkippurim! kohanim shavu lakkahal bishar mitzvot deshana kullah.
Mashiach name, ha shave bishar mitzvot deshana! ella amar rava, ema hachi: mi shechattato shava lichidim, umay nihu kahal.
Rabbi eliezer omer: hannasi mevi sair vechulei. amar rabbi yochanan: lo amar rabbi eliezer ella betumeat mikdash vekadashav, hoil veneemar karet bo kevikvua.

Amar rav pappa: hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach rabbi eliezer al kullehon kaamar, mikkedi seir nasi ufar mashiach bimkom yachid lechattat kae. nitne name: mashiach mevi par bishmiat kol uvittuy sefatayim. ella middela katane mashiach, shema minna attumeat mikdash vekadashav kae, demashiach patur.

Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan lerav pappa: mimmay? dilma rabbi eliezer akkullehon kae, uvemashiach savar la kerabbi akiva, deamar: mashiach patur bechullan! amar leh: verabbi akiva mi patar leh mippar? vetu la middi.

Amar rabbi yochanan: mode rabbi eliezer sheen mevi asham. tane tanna kammeh derav sheshet: asham taluy ba al tumeat mikdash vekadashav. amar leh: daamar lach manni? rabbi eliezer hi, deamar: hoil veneemar bo karet kevikvua, mayyte nasi sair aleha. vehaamar rabbi yochanan: mode rabbi eliezer sheen mevi asham taluy! kashya.
Hadaran alaych hora kohen mashiach

Mishna kohen mashiach shechata veachar kach avar mimmeshichuto, vechen nasi shechata veachar kach avar miggedullato – kohen mashiach mevi par, vehannasi mevi sair. mashiach sheavar mimmeshichuto veachar kach chata, vechen hannasi sheavar miggedullato veachar kach chata – kohen mashiach mevi par, vehannasi kehedyot.
Gemara hasheta yesh lomar: avar mimmeshichuto,

a: Veachar kach chata mevi par, chata veachar kach avar mimmeshichuto tzericha lememar? mishshum dekatane gabbe nasi, dechi avar minnesiuto veachar kach chata – kehedyot mayyte, ahachi tane gabbe mashiach [chata veachar kach avar] mevi par.
Mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "vehikriv al chattato", melammed shemmevi chattato mishsheavar,

Sheyyachol, vahalo din hu: uma nasi shemmevi beshiggat maase – en mevi chattato mishsheavar, mashiach sheen mevi beshiggat maase ella al helem davar im shiggat maase – [lo] kol shekken! talmud lomar: "vehikriv al chattato", melammed shemmevi al chattato mishsheavar.

Venayyte name nasi mikkal vachomer: uma mashiach sheen mevi beshiggat maase – mevi chattat mishsheavar, nasi shemmevi chattat beshiggat maase – eno din shemmevi chattato mishsheavar! talmud lomar: "asher nasi yecheta", keshehu nasi – in, keshehu hedyot – la.
Mishna chatu ad shello nitmannu, veachar kach nitmannu – hare ellu kehedyotot. rabbi shimon omer: im noda lahem ad shello nitmannu – chayyayvim, umishshennitmannu – peturim.
Ezehu nasi? ze melech, shenneemar: "mikkol mitzvot Adonai elohav", sheen al gabbav ella Adonai elohav.
Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "im hakkohen hammashiach yecheta (leashmat)" – perat lakkodmot,
Sheyyachol, vahalo din hu: uma nasi shemmevi beshiggat maase – en mevi al hakkodmot, mashiach sheen mevi ella al helem davar im shiggat maase – eno din shello yavi al hakkodmot!

Lo, im amarta benasi – shekken en mevi chattato mishsheavar, tomar bemashiach – shemmevi chattato mishsheavar, hoil umevi chattato mishsheavar – yavi al hakkodmot? talmud lomar: "hammashiach yecheta", chata keshehu mashiach – mevi, keshehu hedyot – eno mevi.
Vetanya name gabbe nasi kehay gavvna: "asher nasi yecheta" – perat lakkodmot,
Sheyyachol vahalo din hu: uma mashiach shemmevi chattato mishsheavar – eno mevi al hakkodmot, nasi sheen mevi chattato mishsheavar – eno din shello yavi al hakkodmot?

Ma lemashiach shekken en mevi beshiggat maase, tomar benasi shemmevi beshiggat maase? hoil umevi beshiggat maase – yavi al hakkodmot? talmud lomar: "asher nasi yecheta" – shechata vahare hu nasi, velo shechata veodehu hedyot.
Tanu rabbanan: "asher nasi yecheta", yachol gezera? talmud lomar: "im hakkohen hammashiach yecheta", ma lehallan lichsheyyecheta – af kan lichsheyyecheta.
Amar mar: yachol gezera, gezera mehecha tete?

Amri in, ashkechan, dichtiv: "venatatti nega tzaraat bevet eretz achuzzatchem", besora hi lahem shennegaim baim alehem, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: perat lenige onasin. lav amar rabbi yehuda besora? hacha name ema gezera hi! hilkach ketiv: "im".

Ulerabbi shimon, nige onasin mi la metammu? veha tanya: "adam ki yihye" – min haddibbur veelach. vahalo din hu: tame bezav vetame bingaim, ma zav – min haddibbur veelach, af negaim – min haddibbur veelach?

Lo, im amarta bezav shekken en metamme beones, tomar bingaim shemmetammein beones? talmud lomar: "adam ki yihye", min haddibbur veelach. rava amar: perat lenige ruchot. rav pappa amar: perat lenige cheshafim.

Tanu rabbanan: "asher nasi yecheta" – perat lechole. mishshum dehave leh chole, iddechi leh minnesiuteh? amar rav avdimi bar chama: perat lenasi shennitztara, shenneemar: "vaynagga Adonai et hammelech vayhi metzora ad yom moto vayyeshev bevet hachofshit veyotam ben hammelech al habbayit". middekaamar "bevet hachofshit", mikkelal dead hasheta eved hava.

Ki ha derabban gamliel verabbi yehoshua havo azli bisfinta, bahade derabban gamliel hava pitta, bahade rabbi yehoshua hava pitta vesuleta. shelim pitteh derabban gamliel, semach assuleteh derabbi yehoshua. amar leh: mi hava yadat dehave lan ikkuva kulle hay deaytet suleta? amar leh: kochav echad leshivim shana ole umate et (hassefinot) [hassappanim], veamarti: shemma yaale veyate [otanu].

Amar leh: kol kach beyadcha, veatta ole bisfina? amar leh: ad sheatta tameah alay, tema al shene talmidim sheyyesh lecha bayyabbasha, rabbi elazar chassama verabbi yochanan ben gudegda, sheyyodin leshaer kamma tippot yesh bayyam, veen lahem pat leechol velo beged lilbosh! natan dato lehoshivam barosh.
Kesheala, shalach lahem velo bau, chazar veshalach uvau. amar lahem: kimdummin attem shesserara ani noten lachem?
b: Avdut ani noten lachem, shenneemar: "vaydabberu elav lemor im hayyom tihye eved laam hazze".

Tanu rabbanan: "asher nasi yecheta", amar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay: ashre haddor shehannasi shello mevi korban al shiggato. im nasi shello mevi korban, tzarich atta lomar mahu hedyot! veim al shiggato mevi korban, tzarich atta lomar mahu zedono!

Matkef la rava bereh derabba: ella meatta, dichtiv: "veet asher chata min hakkodesh yeshallem", uveyarovam ben nevat, dichtiv beh: "asher chata vaasher hecheti", hachi name deashre haddor hu! shane hacha, deshanni kera bedibbureh.

Darash rav nachman bar rav chisda, may dichtiv: "yesh hevel asher naasa al haaretz vegomer" – ashrehem latztzaddikim, shemmaggia alehem kemaase harshaim shel olam habba baolam hazze. oy lahem larshaim, shemmaggia alehem kemaase hatztzaddikim shel olam habba baolam hazze.

Amar rava: attu tzaddike i achli tere alme mi sene lehu? ella amar rava: ashrehem latztzaddikim shemmaggia alehem kemaase harshaim shel olam hazze baolam hazze, oy lahem larshaim shemmaggia alehem kemaase hatztzaddikim shel olam hazze baolam hazze.

Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua ato lekammeh derava, amar lehu: okemtun massechta pelan umassechta pelan? amaru leh: in. iatteritu pureta? amaru leh: in, dizvanan kattina deara. kare alayyhu: ashrehem latztzaddikim shemmaggia alehem kemaase harshaim shebbaolam hazze baolam hazze.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv: "ki yesharim darche Adonai vetzaddikim yelchu vam ufoshim yikkashlu vam"? mashal lishne bene adam shetztzalu pischehem, echad achalo leshum mitzva, veechad achalo leshum achila gassa. ze sheachalo leshum mitzva – "tzaddikim yelchu vam", ze sheachalo leshum achila gassa – "ufoshim yikkashlu vam".

Amar leh resh lakish: rasha karet leh? nehi dela aved mitzva min hammuvechar, pesach mi la kaachel? ella: mashal lishne bene adam, ze ishto vaachoto immo babbayit, veze ishto vaachoto immo babbayit, echad nizdammena lo ishto, veechad nizdammena lo achoto, ze shennizdammena lo ishto – "tzaddikim yelchu bam", veze shennizdammena lo achoto – "ufoshim yikkashlu vam".

Mi dame? anan kaamrinan chada derech, vehacha shene derachim! ella mashal lelot ushete venotav, hen shennitkavvevnu leshem mitzva – "tzaddikim yelchu vam", hu shennitkavvevn leshem avera – "ufoshim yikkashlu vam".
Vedilma hu name leshem mitzva (hu mechavven) [ikkavvavn]! amar rabbi yochanan, kol happasuk hazze leshem avera neemar.

"Vayyissa lot" – "vattissa eshet adonav et eneha", "et enav" – "vayyomer shimshon [vegomer] otah kach li ki hi yashra veenay", "vayyar" – "vayyar otah shechem ben chamor", "et kol kikkar hayyarden" – "ki vead ishsha zona ad kikkar lachem", "ki chullah mashke" – "elcha achare meahavay notne lachmi umemay tzamri ufishti shamni veshikkuyay".

Veha menas anis! tana mishshum rabbi yose bar rabbi choni: lamma nakud al vav shebbekumah" shel bechira? lomar lach, shebbeshichvah la yada aval bekumah yada. umay hava leh lemebad? may dahava hava! nafka minna dilfanya acharina la ibbei leh lemishte.

Daresh rabba, may dichtiv: "ach nifsha mikkiryat oz umidyanim kivriach armon"? "ach nifsha mikkiryat oz" – ze lot shepperash meavraham, "umidyanim kivriach armon" – shehetil midyanim ben yisrael leammon, shenneemar: "lo yavo ammoni umoavi bikhal Adonai".

Daresh rava, veittema rabbi yitzchak, may dichtiv: "letaava yevakkesh nifrad (uvechol) [bechol] tushiyya yitgalla"? "letaava yevakkesh nifrad" – ze lot shennifrad meavraham. "(uvechol) [bechol] tushiyya yitgalla" – shennitgalla kelono bevatte kenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot. ditnan: ammoni umoavi asurin issur olam.

Veamar ulla: tamar zinneta vezimri zinna. tamar zinneta – yatzu mimmenna melachim uneviim, zimri zinna – naflu kamma revavot miyyisrael. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: gedola avera lishmah mimmitzva shello lishmah, shenneemar: "tevorach minnashim yael eshet chever hakkeni minnashim baohel tevorach", man ninhu "nashim baohel"? sara, rivka, rachel velea.
Ini? vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yaasok adam betora uvemitzvot afillu shello lishmah, shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah. ema: kemitzva shello lishmah.

Amar rabbi yochanan: sheva beilot baal oto rasha beotah shaa, shenneemar: "ben ragleha kara nafal shachav vegomer". veha ka mithanya meavera? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: afillu tovatam shel reshaim raa hi etzel tzaddikim.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yaasok adam battora uvammitzvot afillu shello lishmah, shemmittoch shello lishmah ba lishmah, shebbischar arbaim ushenayim korbanot shehikriv balak harasha, zacha veyatzta mimmennu rut, deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: rut bat beno shel eglon, ben beno shel balak melech moav.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin sheen hakkadosh baruch hu mekappeach afillu sechar sicha naa? mehacha, deillu bechira dikrayteh moav, amar leh rachamana lemoshe: "al tatzar et moav veal titgar vam milchama". milchama

a: Hu dela, ha tzaore tzaarinhu. veillu tzeira dikrayteh "ben ammi", amar leh: "al tetzurem veal titgar bam", kelal, afillu tzaore la.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: leolam yakdim adam lidvar mitzva, shebbischar layla achat shekkadma bechira latztzeira, zachta ukedamatta arba dorot lammalchut.
Tanu rabbanan: "meam haaretz" – perat lemashiach. "meam haaretz" – perat lenasi,

Vahalo kevar yatzu mashiach liddon befar, nasi liddon besair! sheyyachol: mashiach al helem davar im shiggat maase mevi par, al shiggat maase lechodeh mevi kisba useira? talmud lomar: "meam haaretz" – perat lemashiach. "meam haaretz" – perat lenasi.
Tinach mashiach, ella nasi beshiggat maase hu demayyte!

Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: hacha bemay askinan? kegon sheachal kezayit chelev keshehu hedyot, venitmanna veachar kach noda lo. salka datach amena nayyte kisba o seira, kamashma lan. hanicha lerabbi shimon deazel batar yedia, ella lerabbanan (deazlu) [deazli] batar chataa, may ikka lememar?

Ella amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: hacha bemay askinan? kegon sheachal chatzi kezayit chelev keshehu hedyot, venitmanna vehishlimo, veachar kach noda lo. salka datach amena nitzteref venayyte kisba o seira, ka mashma lan.

Bea minneh rava merav nachman: nesiut mahu shettafsik, hechi dame? kegon sheachal chatzi kezayit chelev keshehu hedyot, venitmanna veavar, vehishlimo – hatam hu dela mitzteref, deachleh palga keshehu hedyot ufalga keshehu nasi, aval hacha deidde veidde keshehu hedyot achleh mitzteref, o dilma la shena? may?

Tifshot leh meha deamar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: achal chelev vehifrish korban venishtammed vechazar bo, hoil venidcha – yiddache. hachi hasheta? meshummad lav bar etoye korban hu, hay bar etoye korban hu.

Bea minneh rabbi zera merav sheshet: achal safek chelev keshehu hedyot, venitmanna venoda lo al sefeko, mahu? allibba derabbanan deazli batar chataa la tibbee lach, demayyte asham taluy, ella ki tibbee lach – allibba derabbi shimon.
Middeishtanni levadday, ishtanni lesafek, o dilma ki ishtanni levadday, deishtanni korban dideh – aval hacha dela ishtanni korban dideh, ema layyte asham taluy? teku.
Tanu rabbanan: "meam haaretz" – perat limshummad.
Rabbi shimon bar yose omer mishshum rabbi shimon: "asher lo teasena bishgaga veashem", hashshav bidiato – mevi korban al shiggato, lo shav bidiato – eno mevi korban al shiggato.

May benayyhu? amar rabbi hamenuna: meshummad leechol chelev umevi korban al haddam – ikka benayyhu. mar savar: kevan dimshummad leechol chelev – ledam name meshummad have, umar savar: ledam miha shav bidiato hu.

Veha rava amar: dechulle alma meshummad leechol chelev la have meshummad ledam! ella, hacha beochel nevela leteavon venitchallef lo beshumman vaachalo kamippalgi, mar savar: kevan dilteavon achel bemezid – meshummad hu, umar savar: kevan deillu ashkach dehettera la achal deissura – lav meshummad hu.

Tanu rabbanan: achal chelev – zehu meshummad, veezehu meshummad? achal nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim, veshata yen nesech. rabbi yehuda omer: af hallovesh kilayim. amar mar: achal chelev zehu meshummad, veezehu meshummad? ochel nevelot kulei. may kaamar?

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan, hachi kaamar: achal chelev leteavon – hare ze meshummad, lehacheis – hare ze min. veezehu meshummad devistamo min? heve omer: ochel nevela uterefa, shekatzim uremasim, veshata yen nesech. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: af hallovesh kilayim.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu kilayim derabbanan. mar savar: middeorayyta have meshummad, derabbanan la have meshummad. umar savar: kilayim kevan dimfarsam issureh, afillu bidrabbanan have meshummad.

Peligi ba rav acha veravina, chad amar: leteavon – meshummad, lehacheis – min. vechad amar: lehacheis name meshummad, ella ezehu min? kol haoved avoda zara. metivi: achal parosh echad o yattush echad – hare ze meshummad. veha hacha dilhachis hu, veka kare leh meshummad! hatam deamar: etom taam deissura.

Veezehu nasi? ze melech kulei. tanu rabbanan: "nasi" – yachol nesi shevet kenachshon ben amminadav? talmud lomar: "mikkol mitzvot Adonai elohav", ulehallan: hu omer "lemaan yilmad leyira et Adonai elohav".
b: Ma lehallan sheen al gabbav ella Adonai elohav, af nasi sheen al gabbav ella Adonai elohav.

Bea minneh rabbi merabbi chiyyay: kegon ani, mahu besair? amar leh: hare tzaratcha bevavel. etiveh: malche yisrael umalche bet david, ellu meviim leatzmam, veellu meviim leatzmam! amar leh: hatam la kayyfi ahadade, hacha anan kayyfinan lehu ledidhu.

Rav safra matne hachi. bea minneh rabbi merabbi chiyyay: kegon ani mahu besair? amar leh: hatam "shevet", hacha "mechokek", vetanya: "lo yasur shevet mihuda" – ze rosh gola shebbevavel, sherode et yisrael bemakkel. "umechokek mibben raglav" – ellu bene vanav shel hillel shemlammedim tora leyisrael barabbim.
Mishna veezehu hammashiach? hammashuach beshemen hammishcha, lo hamerubbe bivgadim. en ben kohen hammashuach beshemen hammishcha limrubbe begadim, ella par habba al kol hammitzvot.
Veen ben kohen meshammesh lechohen sheavar ella par yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa.
Ze vaze shavim baavodat yom hakkippurim, umetzuvvivym al habbetula, vaasurim al haalmana, veenam mittammeim bikrovehem, velo porim, velo pormim, umachzirin harotzeach.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: shemen hammishcha sheasa moshe bammidbar hayu sholkim bo et haikkarim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer: vahalo lasuch et haikkarim eno sofek?! ella: shorin et haikkarim bemayim, umetzif alav shemen, vekolet et hareach vekofcho.

Amar lo rabbi yehuda: vechi nes echad naasa beshemen hammishcha? vahalo techillato shenem asar luggin, umimmennu haya nimshach mishkan vechelav aharon uvanav kol shivat yeme hammilluim, vechullo kayyaym leatid lavo, shenneemar: "shemen mishchat kodesh yihye ze li ledorotechem".

Tanya iddach: "vayyikkach moshe et shemen hammishcha vayyimshach [et] hammishkan [veet] kol asher bo", rabbi yehuda omer: shemen hammishcha sheasa moshe bammidbar, kamma nissim naasu bo mittechilla vead sof, techillato lo haya ella shenem asar luggin, ree kamma yora bolaat, vechamma ikkarim bolim, vechamma haur soref, uvo nimshach mishkan vechelav veaharon uvanav kol shivat yeme hammilluim, uvo nimshechu kohanim gedolim umelachim.

Vaafillu kohen gadol ben kohen gadol taun meshicha, veen moshchim melech ben melech. veim tomar: mippene ma mashchu et shelomo? mippene machluketo shel adoniyya, veet yoash mippene atalya, veet yehoachaz mippene yehoyakim, shehaya gadol mimmennu shete shanim. veoto shemen kayyaym leatid lavo, shenneemar: "shemen mishchat kodesh yihye ze li ledorotechem", "ze" – begimatriyya shenem asar luggin havo.

Amar mar: vaafillu kohen gadol ben kohen gadol taun meshicha. menalan? dichtiv: "vehakkohen hammashiach tachtav mibbanav", nema kera "vehakkohen mittachtav mibbanav", may "hammashiach"? ka mashma lan demibbanav dechohen gadol, i have mashiach – have kohen gadol, vei la – la have kohen gadol.

Amar mar: veen moshchin melech ben melech. menalan? amar rav acha bar yaakov, dichtiv: "lemaan yaarich yamim al mamlachto vegomer", yerushsha hi lachem. umenalan dechi ikka machloket bae meshicha, velav kol devae malka moret malchuta livneh, amar rav pappa amar kera: "hu uvanav bekerev yisrael". bizman sheshshalom beyisrael karena beh "hu uvanav", vaafillu belo meshicha.

Tana: af yehu ben nimshi lo nimshach ella mippene machluketo shel yoram. vetippok leh mishshum derishon hu! chassore mechassera vehachi katane: malche bet david meshuchin, malche yisrael en meshuchin. menalan? amar rava, amar kera: "kum meshachehu ki ze vegomer" – ze taun meshicha, veen acher taun meshicha.

Amar mar: af yehu ben nimshi lo nimshach ella mippene machluketo shel yoram. umishshum machluketo shel yoram ben achav nimol beshemen? kidamar rav pappa: baafarsema dachya, hachi name baafarsema dachya.

Veet yehoachaz mippene yehoyakim, shehaya gadol mimmennu shete shanim. umi kashshish minneh? vehachtiv: "uvene yoshiyyahu habbechor yochanan hashsheni yehoyakim hashshelishi tzidkiyyahu harvii shallum", veamar rabbi yochanan: hu shallum hu tzidkiyyahu, hu yochanan hu yehoachaz. leolam yehoyakim kashshish, umay "bechor"? bechor lammalchut.
Umi malchi zutere mikkamme kashshishe? veha ketiv: "veet hammamlacha natan lihoram ki hu habbechor"! yehoram memalle mekom avotav hava, yehoyakim lav memalle mekom avotav hava.

Amar mar: hu shallum hu tzidkiyyahu, hu yochanan hu yehoachaz. veha chad chad ka chashev, dichtiv: "hashshelishi harvii"! may "shelishi" – shelishi labbanim, umay "revii" – revii lammalchut. demeikkara melach yehoachaz, ulevassof yehoyakim, ulevassof yechonya, ulevassof tzidkiyyahu.

Tanu rabbanan: hu shallum hu tzidkiyyahu. velamma nikra shemo shallum? shehaya meshullam bemaasav. ikka deamri: "shallum" – sheshshalma malchut bet david beyamav, uma shemo? mattanya shemo, shenneemar: "vayyamlech melech bavel et mattanya dodo tachtav vayyassev et shemo tzidkiyyahu". amar leh: yah yatzdik alecha et haddin im timrod bi, (shenneemar vayviehu bavela) uchetiv: "vegam bammelech nevuchadnetztzar marad asher hishbio belohim".

a: Umi hava shemen hammishcha? vehatanya: mishshennignaz aron, nignaz shemen hammishcha vetzintzenet hamman umaklo shel aharon shekedeha uferacheha veargaz sheshshalchu pelishtim doron leyisrael, shenneemar: "veet kele hazzahav asher hashevotem lo asham tasimu vaargaz mitztziddo veshillachtem oto vehalach".

Umi genazo? yoshiyyahu melech yehuda genazo, sheraa shekkatuv battora: "yolech Adonai otcha veet malkecha vegomer", tzivva ugenazum, shenneemar: "vayyomer lalviyyim hammevinim lechol yisrael hakkedoshim laAdonai tenu et aron hakkodesh babbayit asher bana shelomo ven david melech yisrael en lachem massa bakkatef atta ivdu et Adonai elohechem veet ammo yisrael".
Veamar rabbi elazar: atya "sham" "sham", atya "mishmeret" "mishmeret", atya "dorot" "dorot"! amar rav pappa: baafarsema dachya.
Tanu rabbanan: ketzad moshchin et hammelachim? kemin nezer. veet hakkohanim? kemin ki. may "kemin ki"? amar rav menashsheya bar gadda: kemin kaf yevani.

Tane chada: battechilla motzkin shemen al rosho, veachar kach notnin lo shemen ben rise enav. vetanya achariti: battechilla notnin lo shemen ben rise enav, veachar kach motzkim lo shemen al rosho! tannae hi, ikka deamri: meshicha adifa, veikka deamri: yetzika adifa.

May tama deman deamar yetzika adifa? dichtiv: "vayyitzok mishshemen hammishcha al rosh aharon vayyimshach oto lekaddesho". uman deamar meshicha adifa, may tama? kasavar: shekken atta motze etzel kele sharet. vehachtiv "vayyitzok", uvassof "vayyimshach"! hachi kaamar: may taam "vayyitzok"? mishshum devayyimshach".

Tanu rabbanan: "kashshemen hattov [vegomer] yored al hazzakan zekan aharon vegomer" – kemin shene tippe margaliyyot hayu teluyot leaharon bizkano. amar rav pappa, tana: keshehu mesapper, olot veyoshvot lo beikkar zekano, veal davar ze haya moshe doeg, amar: shemma chas veshalom maalti beshemen hammishcha? yatzta bat kol veamra: "keshemen hattov vegomer ketal chermon", ma tal chermon en bo meila, af shemen hammishcha shebbizkan aharon en bo meila.
Vaadayin haya aharon doeg, amar: shemma moshe lo maal, aval ani maalti? yatzta bat kol veamra lo: "hinne ma tov uma naim shevet achim gam yachad", ma moshe lo maal, af atta lo maalta.
Tanu rabbanan: en moshchim et hammelachim ella al hammayayn, kede shettimmashech malchutam, shenneemar: "vayyomer hammelech lahem kechu immachem et avde adonechem [vegomer] vehoradtem oto el gichon".
Amar rabbi amme: hay man devae lidda i massek shatteh i la, nitle sheraga baasara yome deven rosh hashshana leyom hakkippurim beveta dela nashev zika. i mashech nehoreh – nidda demassek shatteh.
Uman devae lemibad beiska, uvae lemidda i matzlach i la matzlach, lirabbe tarnegola. i shamen veshafar, matzlach.

Hay man devae lemippak [leorcha] uvae lemidda i (chazar) [hadar] veate leveta, i la – nekum beveta dechabbara, i chaze bavua devavua lidda dehadar veate levete. velav milleta hi, dilma chalsha dateh, umittera mazzaleh. amar abbaye: hasheta deamrat simana milleta hi, [leolam] yehe ragil lemichze beresh shatta kara verubbeya, karate vesilka vetamre.

Amar lehu rav mesharsheya livreh: ki baetu meal umigmaroy kamme rabbayychu, gerusu matnita veallu lekamme rabbayychu. vechi yatvitu kammeh, chazo lefummeh, dichtiv: "vehayu enecha root et morecha". vechi garsitu, gerusu al nahara demayya, dechi hechi demashchin mayya moshchan shematatayychu. vetivu akkilkele demata machseya, vela tivu appadne defumebdita – tav gildana sarya [demata machseya lemechal], mikkuttacha derame kefe.
"Rama karni belohay", "rama karni" velo rama pakki, david ushelomo shennimshechu bekeren – nimshecha malchutan, shaul veyehu shennimshechu befach – lo nimshecha malchutan.

Hammashuach beshemen hammishcha vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "mashiach" – yachol melech? talmud lomar: "kohen". i kohen, yachol merubbe vegadim? talmud lomar: "mashiach". i mashiach, yachol meshuach milchama? talmud lomar: "vehakkohen hammashiach", sheeno mashiach al gabbav.
May mashma? kidamar rava: "hayyarech" – hameyummenet shebbayyarech, hacha name: "hammashiach" – hameyumman shebbammeshuchim.
Amar mar: "mashiach" – yachol melech. melech par hu demayyte? sair hu demayyte! itzterich, salka datach amena: al shiggat maase yavi sair, al helem davar yavi par, ka mashma lan.
En ben mashuach beshemen hammishcha kulei. matnitin dela kerabbi meir, dei rabbi meir, ha tanya: merubbe vegadim mevi par habba al kol hammitzvot, divre rabbi meir, velo hodu lo chachamim.
May tama derabbi meir? detanya: "mashiach" – en li ella mashuach beshemen hammishcha, merubbe vegadim minnayin? talmud lomar: "hakkohen hammashiach".
Bemay okemteh? kerabbanan,
b: Ema sefa: en ben kohen meshammesh lechohen sheavar ella par yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa. atan lerabbi meir. detanya: era bo pesul bechohen gadol veavar uminnu kohen acher tachtav – harishon chozer laavodato, vehashsheni kol mitzvot kehunna alav, divre rabbi meir. [rabbi yose omer: rishon chozer laavodato, vesheni eno rauy lo lechohen gadol velo lechohen hedyot].

Amar rabbi yose: maase beyosef ben illem mitztzippori sheera bo pesul bechohen gadol, veavar, uminnu acher tachtav, velo henichuhu echav hakkohanim lihyot lo kohen gadol velo kohen hedyot. kohen gadol mishshum eva, kohen hedyot mishshum maalin bakkodesh veen moridin.
Resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi meir? amar rav chisda: in, resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi meir. rav yosef amar: rabbi hi, venasev la allibba detannae.
Rava amar: rabbi shimon hi vesavar la kerabbi meir bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.

Detanya: devarim shebben kohen gadol lechohen hedyot ellu hem: par habba al kol hammitzvot, ufar yom hakkippurim, vaasirit haefa, velo porea velo porem. aval hu porem millematta vehahedyot milmala. veen mittamme likrovim, umuzehar al habbetula, veasur baalmana, umachzir et harotzeach,

Umakriv onen, veeno ochel [veeno cholek]. makriv chelek barosh, venotel chelek barosh, umeshammesh bishmona kelim. vechol avodat yom hakkippurim enah keshera ella bo, ufatur al tumeat mikdash vekadashav.

Vechullan nohagin bimrubbe vegadim chutz mippar hammevi al kol hammitzvot, vechullan nohagin bemashiach sheavar chutz mippar yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa, vechullan en nohagin bimshuach milchama chutz mechamishsha devarim haamurim bapparasha: lo porea velo porem, veen mittamme likrovim, umuzehar al habbetula, veasur baalmana, umachazir et harotzeach, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: eno machzir.
Vehay mimmay derabbi shimon hi? amar rav pappa: man shamat leh deamar patur al tumeat mikdash vekadashav? rabbi shimon.

Chutz mechamishsha devarim haamurim bapparasha. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "vehakkohen haggadol meechav" – ze kohen gadol, "asher yutzak al rosho shemen hammishcha" – ze meshuach milchama, "umille et yado lilbosh et habbegadim" – ze merubbe vegadim. al kullan hu omer: "rosho lo yifra uvegadav lo yifrom veal kol nafshot met lo yavo".

Yachol yehu kullan makrivin onnim? talmud lomar: "ki nezer shemen mishchat elohav alav" – "alav" velo al chavero. veachar shechalku hakkatuv, yachol lo yehe metzuvvev al habbetula? talmud lomar: "vehu".
Ketannae: "vehu ishsha vivtuleha yikkach", achar shechillek hakkatuv, ribba. divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: en li ella sheavar mechamat kiryo, mechamat mumin minnayin? talmud lomar: "vehu".
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: mashiach shennitztara, mahu bealmana? midcha dache, o miftar patar? la hava bideh.

Zimnin have yatev rav pappa vekamibbaya leh. amar leh huna bereh derav nachman lerav pappa, tenena: en li ella sheavar mechamat kiryo, avar mechamat mumin minnayin? talmud lomar: "vehu". kam nashshekeh beresheh vihayv leh beratte.
Mishna kohen gadol porem millematta, vehahedyot milmala. kohen gadol makriv onen velo ochel, vehahedyot lo makriv velo ochel.
Gemara amar [rav]: lematta – lematta mammash, lemala – lemala mammash. ushemuel amar: lematta – lematta mikkamme safa, lemala – lemala mikkamme safa. veze vaze batztzavvar.
Metivi: al kol hammetim kullan – ratza mavdil kamme safa shello, ratza eno mavdil kamme safa shello. al aviv veal immo – mavdil, kevan divalma have kera, keri kan "begadav lo yifrom"!
Shemuel kerabbi yehuda sevira leh, deamar: kol kera sheeno mavdil safa shello, eno ella kera shel tiflut. umi it leh lerabbi yehuda keria bechohen gadol?

Veha tanya: illu neemar "rosh lo yifra uveged lo yifrom", hayiti omer: berosh uveged shel sota hakkatuv medabber, talmud lomar: "et rosho lo yifra uvegadav lo yifrom", sheeno bifria uferima kol ikkar, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yishmael omer: eno porem kederech shebbene adam pormin, ella hu millematta vehahedyot milmala.
Shemuel savar la kerabbi yehuda bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.
Mishna kol hattadir mechavero kodem et chavero, vechol hamekuddash mechavero kodem et chavero. par hammashiach ufar haeda omdim – par hammashiach kodem lefar haeda bechol maasav.

Gemara mena hane mille? amar abbaye, deamar kera: "millevad olat habboker asher leolat hattamid", (lema li) mikkede ketiv "olat habboker" – "olat hattamid" lema li? hachi kaamar rachamana: kol ditdira kadma.
Vechol hamekuddash mechavero hu kodem et chavero. menalan? detana deve rabbi yishmael: "vekiddashto" – lechol davar shebbikdushsha: liftoach rishon, ulevarech rishon, velittol mana yafa rishon.

a: Par kohen mashuach ufar eda kulei. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "vesaraf oto kaasher saraf et happar harishon", ma talmud lomar "harishon"? sheyyehe rishon, kodem lefar haeda bechol maasav.

Tanu rabbanan: par kohen mashiach ufar haeda omdim – par kohen mashiach kodem lefar haeda bechol maasav. hoil umashiach mechapper, veeda mitkapperet – din hu sheyyakdim hamechapper lammitkapper, vechen hu omer: "vechipper baado uvead beto uvead kol kehal yisrael".

Par helem davar shel tzibbur kodem lefar shel avoda zara. may tama? hay chattat vehay ola, vetanya: "vehikriv et asher lechattat rishona", ma talmud lomar? im lelammed shettehe chattat rishona, hare kevar neemar: "veet hashsheni yaase ola kammishpat"! ella ze bana av sheyyehu kol chattaot kodmot leolot habbaim immahem, vekayyma lan daafillu chattat haof kodemet leolat behema.
Par avoda zara kodem lisir avoda zara, ammay? hay chattat, vehay ola! amri bemareva mishshemeh derava bar mari: chattat avoda zara chassira alef, "lechattat" ketiv. rava amar: "kammishpat" ketiv beh.
Seir avoda zara kodem lisir nasi. may tama? hay tzibbur vehay yachid. seir nasi kodem lisirat yachid. may tama? hay melech vehay hedyot.

Seirat yachid kodemet lechivsat yachid. veha tanya: kivsat yachid kodemet lisirat yachid! amar abbaye: tannae hi, mar savar: seira adifa, shekken nitrabbeta etzel avoda zara beyachid. umar savar: kivsa adifa, shekken nitrabbeta bealya.
Omer kodem lecheves habba immo, shete hallechem kodmim lichvasim habbaim immahem. ze hakkelal: davar habba begin (la)yom kodem ledavar habba begin lechem.
Mishna haish kodem laishsha lehachayot ulehashev aveda. vehaishsha kodemet laish lichsut ulehotzi mibbet hashshevi. bizman sheshshenehem omdim bekalkala – haish kodem laishsha.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: haya hu veaviv verabbo bashshevi – hu kodem lerabbo, verabbo kodem leaviv. immo kodemet lechullam.
Chacham kodem lemelech yisrael: chacham shemmet – en lanu kayyotze bo. melech yisrael shemmet – kol yisrael reuyim lammalchut.
Melech kodem lechohen gadol, shenneemar: "vayyomer hammelech (alehem) [lahem] kechu immachem (o meavde) [et avde] adonechem vegomer".

Kohen gadol kodem lenavi, shenneemar: "umashach oto sham tzadok hakkohen venatan hannavi". hikdim tzadok lenatan. veomer: "shema na yehoshua hakkohen haggadol atta vereecha vegomer". yachol hedyotot hayu? talmud lomar: "ki anshe mofet hemma", veen "mofet" ella navi, shenneemar: "venatan elecha ot o mofet".

Mashuach beshemen hammishcha kodem limrubbe vegadim. merubbe vegadim kodem lemashiach sheavar mechamat kiryo. mashiach sheavar mechamat kiryo kodem leavar mechamat mumo. avar mechamat mumo kodem limshuach milchama. meshuach milchama kodem lisgan.
Segan kodem laamarkol. may amarkol? amar rav chisda: amar kolla. amarkol kodem legizbar, gizbar kodem lerosh mishmar, rosh mishmar kodem lerosh bet av, rosh bet av kodem lechohen hedyot.
Ibbaya lehu: leinyan tumea, segan umeshuach milchama eze mehem kodem?

Amar mar zutera bereh derav nachman: ta shema, detanya: segan umeshuach milchama shehayu mehallechim badderech ufaga bahem met mitzva, mutav sheyyittamme meshuach milchama veal yittamme segan, sheim yeera bo pesul bechohen gadol, nichnas hassegan umeshammesh tachtav. vehatanya: meshuach milchama kodem lassegan! amar ravina, ki tanya hahi lehacheyoto.

Mishna kohen kodem lelevi, levi leyisrael, yisrael lemamzer, umamzer lenatin, venatin leger, veger leeved meshucherar. ematay? bizman shekkullam shavim. aval im haya mamzer talmid chacham vechohen gadol am haaretz – mamzer talmid chacham kodem lechohen gadol am haaretz.

Gemara kohen kodem lelevi – shenneemar: "(uvene) [bene] amram aharon umoshe vayyibbadel aharon (lehakeriv) [lehakedisho] kodesh (hakkodashim) [kadashim]". levi kodem leyisrael – shenneemar: "baet hahi hivdil Adonai et shevet hallevi (mittoch) vegomer".

Yisrael kodem lemamzer – shezze meyuchas, veze eno meyuchas. mamzer kodem lenatin – ze ba mittippa keshera, veze ba mittippa pesula. natin kodem leger – ze gadal immanu bikdushsha, veze lo gadal immanu bikdushsha. ger kodem leeved meshucherar – ze haya bichlal arur, veze lo haya bichlal arur.
Ematay? bizman shekkullan shavin kulei. mena hane mille? amar rav acha berabbi chanina, deamar kera: "yekara hi mippeninim", mikkohen gadol shennichnas lifnay velifnim.

Tanya, rabbi shimon bar yochay omer: baddin hu sheyyakdim eved meshucherar leger, shezze gadal immanu bikdushsha, veze lo gadal immanu bikdushsha. ella ze haya bichlal arur, veze lo haya bichlal arur.

Shaalu talmidav et rabbi elazar berabbi tzadok: mippene ma hakkol ratzin lissa giyyoret, veen hakkol ratzin lissa meshuchereret? amar lahem: zo hayta bichlal arur, vezo lo hayta bichlal arur. davar acher: zo hayta bechezkat shamur, vezo lo hayta bechezkat shamur.

Shaalu talmidav et rabbi elazar: mippene ma hakkelev makkir et kono, vechatul eno makkir et kono? amar lahem: uma haochel mimma sheachbar ochel – meshakkeach, haochel achbar atzmo – al achat kamma vechamma.
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi eliezer: mippene ma hakkol moshlim baachbarim? mippene shessuran ra. may hi? rava amar: afillu gelime gayytzi.
b: Rav pappa amar: afillu shufeta [d]mara gayytzi.

Tanu rabbanan. chamishsha devarim meshakkechim et hattalmud: haochel mimma sheochel achbar umimma sheochel chatul, vehaochel lev shel behema, veharagil bezetim, vehashshote mayim shel shiyyure rechitza, veharochetz raglav zo al gabbe zo. veyesh omrim: af hammanniach kelav tachat meraashotav. chamishsha devarim meshivim et hattalmud: pat pechamin vechol shekken pechamin atzman, vehaochel betza megulegelet belo melach, veharagil beshemen zayit, veharagil beyayin uvesamim, vehashshote mayim shel shiyyure issa. veyesh omrim: af hattovel etzbao bemelach veochel.
"Haragil beshemen zayit". mesayyay leh lerabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan: keshem shehazzayit meshakkeach talmud shel shivim shana, kach shemen zayit meshiv talmud shel shivim shana.
"Veharagil beyayin uvesamim". mesayyay leh lerava, deamar rava: chamra verechane pakkachin.
"Vehattovel etzbao bemelach", amar resh lakish: uveachat. ketannae, rabbi yehuda omer: achat velo shetayim, rabbi yose omer: shetayim velo shalosh. vesimanaych: kemitza.

Asara devarim kashim lattalmud: haover tachat haafsar [haggamal] vechol shekken tachat gamal [atzmo], vehaover ben shene gemallim, vehaover ben shete nashim, vehaishsha haoveret ben shene anashim, vehaover mittachat reach ra shel nevela, vehaover tachat haggesher shello avru tachtav mayim arbaim yom, vehaochel pat shello bashal kol tzarko, vehaochel basar mizzuhama listeron, vehashshote meammat hammayim haoveret bevet hakkevarot, vehammistakkel bifne hammet. veyesh omrim: af hakkore ketav sheal gabbe hakkever.

Tanu rabbanan: keshehannasi nichnas, kol haam omdim, veen yoshvim ad sheomer lahem: shevu. kesheav bet din nichnas, osim lo shura achat mikkan veshura achat mikkan, ad sheyyeshev bimkomo. keshechacham nichnas, echad omed veechad yoshev, ad sheyyeshev bimkomo. bene chachamim vetalmide chachamim, bizman sherabbim tzerichim lahem – mafsiin al rashe haam. yatza letzorech – yikkanes veyeshev bimkomo.

Bene talmide chachamim shemmemunnim avihem parnas al hatztzibbur, bizman sheyyesh lahem daat lishmoa – nichnasim veyoshvim lifne avihem vaachorehem kelappe haam. bizman sheen lahem daat lishmoa – nichnasim veyoshvim lifne avihem ufenehem kelappe haam. rabbi elazar bar rabbi [tzadok] omer: af bevet hammishte osim otam senifin.

[Amar mar] yatza letzorech – nichnas veyoshev bimkomo. amar rav pappa: lo amru ella liktannim, aval ligdolim – la, hava leh lemivdak nafsheh meikkara. deamar rav yehuda amar rav: leolam yelammed adam atzmo lehashekim ulehaariv, kede shello yitrachek. amar rava: haiddana dachalasho alma – afillu ligdolim name.
Rabbi elazar bar rabbi [tzadok] omer: af bevet hammishte osim otam senifim. amar rava: bechayye avihem bifne avihem.

Amar rabbi yochanan: bime rabban shimon ben gamliel nishnet mishna zo. rabban shimon ben gamliel nasi, rabbi meir chacham, rabbi natan av bet din. ki hava rabban shimon ben gamliel hatam, havo kayymi kulle alma mikkammeh. ki havo ayyli rabbi meir verabbi natan, havo kayymi kulle alma mikkammayyhu. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: la bau lemihve hekkera ben dili ledidhu? takken ha matnita.
Hahu yoma la havo rabbi meir verabbi natan hatam, limchar ki ato chazo dela kamu mikkammayyhu kedirgila milleta, amri: may hay? amaru lehu: hachi takken rabban shimon ben gamliel.

Amar leh rabbi meir lerabbi natan: ana chacham veat av bet din, netakken milleta ki ledidan. may naaved leh? nema leh: galli uketzim, delet leh. vechevan dela gemir, nema leh: "mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato", lemi nae lemallel gevurot Adonai – mi sheyyachol lehashemia kol tehillotav. neabbereh, vehave ana av bet din veat nasi.
Shaminhu rabbi yaakov ben kudshay, amar: dilma chas veshalom atya milleta lide kissufa, azal yetev achore illiteh derabban shimon ben gamliel, peshat, geras utena, geras utena.
Amar: may dekamma? dilma chas veshalom ikka be midresha midde, yehav dateh vegarsa. limchar amaru leh: nete mar venitne beuketzin, petach vaamar. batar deokem, amar lehu: i la gemirna, kassefytunan.

Pakked veappekinhu mibbe midresha. havo katvi kusheyayta [befitka] veshadu hatam. dahava mipperik – mipperik, dela havo mipperik – katvi peruke veshadu. amar lehu rabbi yose: tora mibbachutz veanu mibbifnim?

Amar lahen rabban [shimon ben] gamliel: niayyeylinhu, mihu niknesinhu dela nemru shemata mishshemayyhu. assiku lerabbi meir acherim, ulerabbi natan yesh omrim. achvo lehu bechelmayyhu: zilu payyeysuhu [lerabban shimon ben gamliel], rabbi natan azal, rabbi meir la azal, amar: divre chalomot lo maalin velo moridin. ki azal rabbi natan, amar leh rabban shimon ben gamliel: nehi deahani lach kamra daavuch lemeheve av bet din, shavvinaych name nasi?!
